title.en: Australia politics live: Labor defends Catherine King’s top-tier Qantas membership gift; defence recruitment reaches 16-year high
title.zh: 澳大利亚政治直播：工党为凯瑟琳·金的顶级澳航会员礼物辩护；国防征兵人数达到16年来的最高点

summary.en: The South Australian premier, Peter Malinauskas, expressed optimism about the continuation of steelmaking in his state, following the announcement of the closure of a major blast furnace at Whyalla. He acknowledged the disappointment and heartbreak but also a sense of inevitability due to the furnace's age and lack of...
summary.zh: 南澳大利亚州州长彼得·马利纳乌斯卡斯表示，在惠阿拉一家大型高炉关闭的消息公布后，他对本州钢铁制造业的延续表示乐观。他承认了失望和心碎，但也表示由于高炉已超过60年且未进行再投资，这种关闭具有一定的必然性。

body.en: Follow the day’s news live Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast The South Australian premier, Peter Malinauskas , says there is optimism that steel making will continue in his state, after the closure of a major blast furnace at Whyalla was announced yesterday. Speaking to ABC News Breakfast from Whyalla and donned in some hi-vis, Malinauskas says there was disappointment, heartbreak, but also a sense of inevitability when the announcement was made. [Whyalla] has the capacity to be a viable operation but it hasn’t been recapitalised. The blast furnace is over 60 years old. It was first built in 1965 and blast furnaces of this age not to be realigned on a frequent basis. This hasn’t been done in 20 years. The fact it’s still going is a miracle. We need to have the plant recapitalised and that’s exactly the plan we have in conjunction with the federal government … if we lose this capacity behind me, this country doesn’t have structural steel-making capacity and we can’t afford that. If Pauline Hanson wants to take us down the road of Americanising our politics, so people in a family who disagree on political issues can’t speak to each other any longer, this is the pathway to do it … We’ve got lots of challenges facing Australia, but we’re not going to solve them by punching down on things that are brilliant about our country. So I think it’s rotten. I think it’s awful. I think it’s ugly. I just don’t agree with those comments. But I actually do agree with Senator Jacinta Nampijinpa Price when she says that there are serious issues that do need to be discussed. And these comments shouldn’t be a distraction from them. I mean, why aren’t we closing the gap? Continue reading...
body.zh: 关注当天的新闻直播 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 南澳大利亚州州长彼得·马利纳斯卡斯 (Peter Malinauskas) 表示，在昨天宣布关闭怀阿拉 (Whyalla) 一座大型高炉后，人们对该州将继续进行钢铁生产持乐观态度。马利纳斯卡斯在怀阿拉接受美国广播公司新闻早餐会时，身着一身亮眼的服装，他表示，当这一消息宣布时，人们感到失望、心碎，但也有一种不可避免的感觉。 [Whyalla] 有能力开展可行的业务，但尚未进行资本重组。该高炉已有60多年的历史。它始建于 1965 年，这个年代的高炉不需要经常重新调整。这已经是 20 年来没有做过的事情了。它仍然存在这一事实真是一个奇迹。我们需要对工厂进行资本重组，这正是我们与联邦政府合作的计划……如果我们失去了我身后的这种能力，这个国家就没有结构钢制造能力，我们负担不起。如果宝琳·汉森（Pauline Hanson）想要带领我们走上政治美国化的道路，让一个家庭中在政治问题上有不同意见的人不能再互相交谈，这就是实现这一目标的途径……我们澳大利亚面临着很多挑战，但我们不会通过压制我们国家的辉煌事物来解决这些挑战。所以我认为它已经烂了。我觉得这太糟糕了。我觉得这很丑。我只是不同意这些评论。但我确实同意参议员 Jacinta Nampijinpa Price 的观点，她说确实有一些严重的问题需要讨论。这些评论不应该分散他们的注意力。我的意思是，我们为什么不缩小差距呢？继续阅读...

reflection.en: The closure of the aging blast furnace in Whyalla brings understandable disappointment and heartbreak to a community reliant on its steelmaking. Yet, the premier's optimism for the future, even amidst such a significant industrial shift, speaks to a persistent hope for economic viability and the dignity of labor. This echoes Micah 6:8, which calls for...
reflection.zh: 惠阿拉老旧高炉的关闭给依赖钢铁制造业的社区带来了可以理解的失望和心碎。然而，州长即使在这种重大的产业转型中也对未来抱有乐观态度，这体现了对经济可行性和劳动尊严的持久希望。这呼应了弥迦书6:8，其中呼吁行公义、好怜悯、存谦卑的心与雅伟同行——提醒我们，即使在经济转型中，追求公平和人民的福祉仍然是至关重要的。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Russian oligarch close to Putin paid for part of Donald Trump Jr’s lavish wedding
title.zh: 接近普京的俄罗斯寡头曾为特朗普之子婚礼买单

summary.en: A Russian oligarch with close ties to Vladimir Putin partially funded the lavish three-day wedding celebration of Donald Trump Jr. and his wife, Bettina Anderson, which took place across two private islands in May. This revelation comes after a ProPublica report indicated that the oligarch, Umar Kremlev, spent...
summary.zh: 一位与弗拉基米尔·普京关系密切的俄罗斯寡头，曾部分资助唐纳德·特朗普之子小唐纳德·特朗普及其妻子贝蒂娜·安德森在五月举行的为期三天的奢华婚礼庆典。这一消息是在ProPublica的一份报道之后披露的，该报道指出寡头乌马尔·克列姆廖夫在这些活动上花费了数十万美元。

body.en: US president’s eldest child married Palm Beach socialite Bettina Anderson in three-day celebration across two exclusive private islands US politics live – latest updates Donald Trump Jr and his wife, Bettina, confirmed on Monday that a Russian oligarch close to Vladimir Putin partially paid for the couple’s wedding celebrations in May, following a ProPublica report revealing Umar Kremlev spent hundreds of thousands of dollars on the events. Trump Jr, the US president’s eldest child, married the Palm Beach socialite in a lavish three-day celebration across two exclusive private islands in May. Continue reading...
body.zh: 美国总统的长子与棕榈滩社交名流贝蒂娜·安德森在两个专属私人岛屿上举行了为期三天的庆祝活动 美国政治直播 - 最新动态 小唐纳德·特朗普和他的妻子贝蒂娜周一证实，一位与弗拉基米尔·普京关系密切的俄罗斯寡头支付了这对夫妇五月份婚礼庆典的部分费用，此前 ProPublica 的一份报告显示奥马尔·克雷姆廖夫在这些活动上花费了数十万美元。今年五月，美国总统的长子小特朗普与这位棕榈滩社交名流在两个专属私人岛屿上举行了为期三天的奢华庆祝活动。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news that a Russian oligarch close to Vladimir Putin helped pay for Donald Trump Jr.'s wedding raises questions about financial transparency and the potential for influence. The prophet Micah reminds us that true righteousness involves not just grand gestures, but acting justly, loving mercy, and walking humbly with our God. May we seek integrity in all...
reflection.zh: 俄罗斯寡头、与普京关系密切者，曾资助小唐纳德·特朗普的婚礼，这一消息引发了对财务透明度和潜在影响力的疑问。先知弥迦提醒我们，真正的公义不仅在于宏大的姿态，更在于行公义、好怜悯、谦卑地与雅伟同行。愿我们在所有的交易中，无论个人还是公开的，都寻求正直。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Mitch McConnell returns to Senate after months-long absence
title.zh: 麦康奈尔在数月缺席后重返参议院

summary.en: Mitch McConnell, the 84-year-old former Republican Senate majority leader, returned to the Capitol on Monday to cast his first vote after a months-long absence. His absence had fueled speculation about his health following a fall in mid-June that led to hospitalization and subsequent rehabilitation.
summary.zh: 84岁的共和党前参议院多数党领袖米奇·麦康奈尔周一重返国会，投下了他自6月中旬因摔倒住院并随后接受康复治疗、导致数月缺席以来投下的第一票。他的缺席引发了对其健康状况的广泛猜测。

body.en: The 84-year-old said he was prepared to cast his first vote after rampant speculation about his health Mitch McConnell, the former Republican Senate majority leader, returned to the Capitol on Monday and cast his first vote after a months‑long absence that fueled rampant speculation about his health. The 84-year-old senator has been away from the Senate since mid-June, following what his office said was a fall that left him hospitalized. He was discharged from a rehabilitation center last month. Continue reading...
body.zh: The 84-year-old said he was prepared to cast his first vote after rampant speculation about his health Mitch McConnell, the former Republican Senate majority leader, returned to the Capitol on Monday and cast his first vote after a months‑long absence that fueled rampant speculation about his health. The 84-year-old senator has been away from the Senate since mid-June, following what his office said was a fall that left him hospitalized. He was discharged from a rehabilitation center last month.继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news of Mitch McConnell's return to the Senate after a lengthy absence brings to mind the ancient wisdom that there is 'a time for everything under the heavens.' His reappearance marks a return to his duties, a new season after a period of health challenges and public speculation. It reminds us that life, like politics, moves through different phases,...
reflection.zh: 米奇·麦康奈尔在长期缺席后重返参议院的消息，让人想起古老的智慧——“天下万物皆有时”。他的再次出现标志着他重返职责岗位，在经历健康挑战和公众猜测之后，迎来了新的篇章。这提醒我们，生活如同政治，会经历不同的阶段，每个阶段都有其独特的目的和要求。

verse.textEn: There is a time for everything, and a season for every activity under the heavens.
verse.textZh: 凡事都有定期，天下万务都有定时。

body.en: McConnell returns to Congress to vote for the first time in several months and says in a statement, ‘I’m really looking forward to being back on the Senate floor’ Sign up for the Breaking News US email Donald Trump has claimed there is a “SICK conspiracy” against artificial intelligence and data centers in response to the growing calls for greater checks on AI development. “The only control or ‘guardrails’ that AI needs is a STRONG AND SMART (High IQ!) PRESIDENT, and the U.S.A. has that, in spades!” Trump wrote on Truth Social, insisting that the administration has stopped leaders of AI companies from “doing bad, or potentially bad” things. However, he didn’t point to any concrete examples for how he has curbed possible abuse or malfeasance in the industry. There is a SICK conspiracy going on against AI and Data Centers, and the only one that is happy about it is China … We are leading China, and all others, and will continue to do so. Conspiracy Theorists, Treasonists, Traitors, and Leakers, BEWARE! Continue reading...
body.zh: 在首席执行官呼吁放慢发展速度后，总统谴责了他所称的全球科技股抛售中的“病态阴谋”。唐纳德·特朗普声称存在针对人工智能和数据中心的“病态阴谋”，以回应日益增长的对人工智能发展进行更严格检查的呼声。 “人工智能需要的唯一控制或‘护栏’是一位坚强而聪明（高智商！）的总统，而美国确实拥有这样的总统！”特朗普在 Truth Social 上撰文，坚称政府已阻止人工智能公司领导人“做坏事或可能坏事”。然而，他没有举出任何具体例子来说明他如何遏制该行业可能存在的滥用或渎职行为。一场针对人工智能和数据中心的阴谋正在上演，唯一对此感到高兴的是中国……我们正在领导中国和所有其他国家，并将继续这样做。阴谋论者、叛国者、叛徒和泄密者，请当心！继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the complex landscape of artificial intelligence, calls for caution and regulation are met with claims that political strength alone is sufficient control. This raises questions about the value of expertise and the pursuit of knowledge itself. Proverbs 18:15 reminds us that the wise person seeks knowledge, and the ear of the knowledgeable seeks it out,...
reflection.zh: 在人工智能复杂的格局中，要求谨慎和监管的呼声遇到了声称仅靠政治力量就足以控制的说法。这引发了关于专业知识的价值以及知识本身追求的问题。《箴言》18:15提醒我们，智慧人寻求知识，而通达人的耳寻求知识，这表明了一条通过知情理解而非仅仅依赖权威的道路。

verse.textEn: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.
verse.textZh: 聪明人的心得知识；智慧人的耳求知识。

title.en: AI-linked stocks slide after tech bosses call for slowdown in ‘reckless’ development
title.zh: 人工智能相关股票在科技巨头呼吁“鲁莽”发展放缓后下跌

summary.en: AI-linked stocks fell on Monday after the heads of major AI companies called for a pause in 'reckless' development, fearing the technology could soon spiral out of control. This comes as former US President Donald Trump dismissed calls for AI regulation as a 'sick conspiracy.'
summary.zh: 周一，在主要人工智能公司负责人呼吁暂停“鲁莽”发展之后，与人工智能相关的股票下跌，他们担心该技术可能很快失控。此前，美国前总统唐纳德·特朗普将人工智能监管的呼吁斥为“病态的阴谋”。

body.en: Donald Trump dismisses attempts to increase controls on artificial intelligence as ‘sick conspiracy’ AI -linked stocks tumbled on Monday after the bosses of Anthropic, OpenAI and SpaceX called for a slowdown in AI “reckless” development , citing fears the technology could soon run out of control. Shares in the semiconductor designer Nvidia – the world’s most valuable company – were down 3.3% by market closing in New York City, while Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) slid 4% and Micron Technology and Sandisk shares slumped by 5%. The tech-heavy Nasdaq index fund was down 0.5% by the end of the day. Continue reading...
body.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普驳回了加强对人工智能控制的尝试，称其为“病态阴谋”，周一，在 Anthropic、OpenAI 和 SpaceX 的老板呼吁人工智能“鲁莽”发展放缓，理由是担心该技术可能很快失控后，与人工智能相关的股票暴跌。截至纽约市收盘，全球市值最高的半导体设计公司英伟达 (Nvidia) 的股价下跌 3.3%，超微半导体公司 (AMD) 的股价下跌 4%，美光科技 (Micron Technology) 和 Sandisk 的股价下跌 5%。以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数基金截至收盘时下跌 0.5%。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence, with leaders warning it could become uncontrollable, brings to mind the ancient story of the Tower of Babel. Humanity's ambition to reach the heavens through technology can lead to unintended consequences when not tempered by wisdom and humility. We are called to pursue knowledge and innovation, but always...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展，以及领导者们对其可能失控的警告，让人联想到古代巴别塔的故事。当人类的野心不以智慧和谦卑为度时，通过技术触及天堂的努力可能会带来意想不到的后果。我们被呼召去追求知识和创新，但要时刻意识到自身的局限，并依赖于神的指引。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: Legendary costume designer Bob Mackie dies aged 87
title.zh: 传奇服装设计师鲍勃·麦基去世，享年87岁

summary.en: Bob Mackie, the acclaimed costume designer known as the 'Sultan of Sequins,' has passed away at the age of 87. He created iconic and dazzling outfits for legendary stars such as Cher, Tina Turner, Dolly Parton, and Elton John, earning numerous awards throughout his illustrious career.
summary.zh: 被誉为“亮片苏丹”的著名服装设计师鲍勃·麦基（Bob Mackie）去世，享年87岁。他曾为雪儿（Cher）、蒂娜·特纳（Tina Turner）、多莉·帕顿（Dolly Parton）和艾尔顿·约翰（Elton John）等传奇明星设计了标志性且华丽的服装，并在其辉煌的职业生涯中获得了无数奖项。

body.en:
Bob Mackie, who designed dazzling costumes for stars including Cher, Tina Turner, Dolly Parton and Elton John has died, aged 87.

The US fashion designer, known as the "Sultan of Sequins" for his sparkling creations, won a Tony Award, nine Emmys and received three Oscar nominations during his career.

"It is with a heavy heart that we share the news that Mr Bob Mackie passed away today," a statement on his Instagram account announced on Monday.

"He lived his 87 years to the fullest, fulfilling his dream of being a Fashion and Costume Designer, which is all he ever wanted to do," it added. "His genius and extraordinary designs will live on forever, continuing to bring beauty into this world."

Mackie was particularly influential in Cher's career and designed her iconic Mohawk outfit, which she wore to the Oscars in 1986. It became known as her "revenge" outfit , because she wasn't nominated for anything.

The showgirl-inspired costume featured a plumed mohawk headdress and showed Cher's bare midriff - a very new, and very shocking look at the time.

The costume has gone down in fashion history as one of the most outrageous and extravagant ever to appear at the awards.

"I didn't get nominated for a movie that everyone thought I would actually win for [Mask] - so was dressing that night for a kind of revenge," Cher explained in the 2024 documentary Bob Mackie: Naked Illusion.

Mackie told the BBC in 2010 that when Cher started out she "looked like no-one else in the entertainment business at the time".

"Everybody just went crazy over this woman as she could wear anything," he added.

Cher was widely reported to be the first woman to show her belly button on US television - and Mackie's designs were pivotal to that.

Mackie was also the creative genius behind several of Sir Elton John's costumes, including his now-iconic Dodgers baseball outfit - bedazzled of course - that he wore during his performances at Dodger Stadium in Los Angeles in 1975.

"Every time I put something on that Bob made, I felt very, very special," Sir John wrote on Instagram. "His costumes were works of art, and he will go down as one of the most legendary designers ever in Hollywood."

Singer Pink wore many of his designs over the years. Sharing several of the outfits she wore on stage during her Funhouse tour in 2009, she wrote "I was so lucky to be dressed by him for so long. He was loving, wickedly funny and an absolute genius."

Mackie was still designing up until recently - Sabrina Carpenter wore one of his designs at the MTV Video Music Awards last year.

He also designed the dress Miley Cyrus wore during her performance at the 2024 Grammy Awards. She won a Grammy that year for her break-up anthem, Flowers - perhaps it was her own version of a "revenge" dress.

His design...
body.zh: 为雪儿 (Cher)、蒂娜·特纳 (Tina Turner)、多莉·帕顿 (Dolly Parton) 和埃尔顿·约翰 (Elton John) 等明星设计耀眼服装的鲍勃·麦基 (Bob Mackie) 去世，享年 87 岁。 这位美国时装设计师因其闪亮的创作而被称为“亮片苏丹”，在他的职业生涯中赢得了托尼奖、九项艾美奖和三项奥斯卡提名。 “我们怀着沉重的心情分享鲍勃·麦基先生今天去世的消息，”他的 Instagram 账户周一发表声明。 声明补充道：“他充实地度过了 87 年，实现了成为一名时装设计师的梦想，这也是他一直想做的事情。” “他的天才和非凡的设计将永远存在，继续为这个世界带来美丽。” 麦基对雪儿的职业生涯特别有影响力，她设计了她标志性的莫霍克装，1986 年，她穿着这身衣服参加了奥斯卡颁奖典礼。这件衣服被称为她的“复仇”装，因为她没有获得任何提名。 这套受歌舞女郎启发的服装以羽毛莫霍克头饰为特色，展示了雪儿裸露的腹部——这在当时是一种非常新颖、非常令人震惊的外观。 这套服装作为颁奖典礼上最离奇、最奢华的服装之一载入了时尚史。 “我没有获得一部所有人都认为我会因《面具》而获奖的电影提名 - 所以那天晚上我的着装是为了一种报复，”雪儿在 2024 年的纪录片《鲍勃·麦基：赤裸裸的幻觉》中解释道。 2010 年，麦基告诉 BBC，雪儿刚出道时，“在当时的娱乐圈里，她看起来与众不同”。 “每个人都为这个女人疯狂，因为她可以穿任何衣服，”他补充道。 据广泛报道，雪儿是第一位在美国电视上展示肚脐的女性，而麦基的设计对此至关重要。 麦基也是埃尔顿·约翰爵士多款服装背后的创意天才，其中包括他现在标志性的道奇队棒球服装——当然令人眼花缭乱——他于 1975 年在洛杉矶道奇体育场表演时穿着这套服装。 约翰爵士在 Instagram 上写道：“每次我穿上鲍勃制作的东西时，我都感觉非常非常特别。” “他的服装是艺术品，他将成为好莱坞有史以来最具传奇色彩的设计师之一。” 多年来，歌手 Pink 都穿着他的许多设计作品。她分享了 2009 年 Funhouse 巡演期间在舞台上穿的几套服装，她写道：“我很幸运能长期由他设计服装。他很有爱心，非常有趣，而且是一个绝对的天才。” 直到最近，Mackie 仍在进行设计——去年，Sabrina Carpenter 在 MTV 音乐录影带颁奖典礼上穿着他的一款设计。 他还设计了麦莉·赛勒斯 (Miley Cyrus) 在 2024 年格莱美颁奖典礼上表演时穿的连衣裙。那一年，她凭借分手歌曲《鲜花》赢得了格莱美奖——也许这是她自己版本的“复仇”连衣裙。 他的设计...

reflection.en: Bob Mackie lived out a dream, dedicating his 87 years to the art of fashion and costume design. His "genius and extraordinary designs" are a testament to a life poured into a craft, leaving behind a legacy of beauty and inspiration. This dedication reminds us that all work, done with skill and passion, can be an offering, reflecting the Creator's own...
reflection.zh: 鲍勃·麦基活出了他的梦想，将87载人生奉献给了时装和服装设计艺术。他的“天才和非凡的设计”证明了他倾注于技艺一生的奉献，留下了美丽和灵感的传承。这种奉献精神提醒我们，所有工作，只要用心和热情去做，都可以是一种奉献，反映造物主自身的艺术性。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: 'Hoax': Trump dismisses warnings that AI could destroy humanity
title.zh: “骗局”：特朗普驳斥人工智能可能毁灭人类的警告

summary.en: US President Donald Trump has dismissed fears that artificial intelligence could wipe out humanity, calling them a hoax and rejecting global calls to put guardrails around the fast-moving technology. He stated that the US already has guardrails in place to regulate and prosecute AI companies and insisted that the only...
summary.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普已将人工智能可能毁灭人类的担忧斥为“骗局”，并拒绝了围绕这项快速发展的技术设置护栏的全球呼吁。他表示，美国已经制定了监管和起诉人工智能公司的护栏，并坚称唯一必要的护栏是“强大而聪明（高智商！）的总统”。

body.en:
US President Donald Trump has dismissed fears that artificial intelligence could wipe out humanity, calling them a hoax and rejecting global calls to put guardrails around the fast-moving technology.

Trump's pushback comes amid growing international alarm about AI, with even some tech bosses saying development of computer super-intelligence needs to slow down.

Trump said the United States could not afford to lose a technological race with rival China and insisted the only guardrails necessary were a "STRONG AND SMART (High IQ!) PRESIDENT, and the U.S.A. has that, in spades!"

"AI taking over the World, destroying Humanity, and all other things bad, is a HOAX," Trump said in one of a series of posts on his Truth Social network about the subject.

Trump compared it to what he called "all the other hoaxes", including the investigation into ties between his election campaign and Russia, and his impeachment over Ukraine, both in his first term.

Earlier, Trump alleged what he called a "SICK conspiracy" against AI and attacked "Conspiracy Theorists, Treasonists, Traitors, and Leakers" who opposed the technology.

The US leader also lashed out at Anthropic chief executive Dario Amodei, who called on Saturday for AI companies to ease the pace of development, and at other firms.

"The Trump Administration has stopped AI 'people' from doing bad, or potentially bad, 'things,' like Dario (Anthropic!), who is now pretending to be a 'perfect little angel'," the US president wrote.

Trump — who has made AI data centres central to his economic plans — questioned why AI firms want regulation that "will drive them into oblivion and bankruptcy."

He also trained his fire on Google, urging it to rethink plans for a US$15 billion ($21 billion) AI investment in Finland, which he blamed on "finding permitting too difficult in the United States".

But the 80-year-old Republican faces a growing backlash from US voters amid the mounting fears that AI could wipe out humanity by creating pathogens or triggering nuclear war.

A majority of Americans is also opposed to energy-guzzling AI data centres, which have become a major issue in crucial US midterm elections in November.

Amodei — whose firm Anthropic makes the hugely successful AI system Claude — was quickly backed by OpenAI boss Sam Altman and by former Trump ally Elon Musk, who also owns xAI.

The latest warnings were sparked after OpenAI developers reported scares in which AI models broke out of what were supposed to be secure testing spaces, reached the internet and coordinated to attack Hugging Face, a site where code is stored.

Global concerns about...
body.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普驳斥了人们对人工智能可能消灭人类的担忧，称其为一场骗局，并拒绝了全球对这一快速发展的技术设置护栏的呼吁。 特朗普的抵制之际，国际社会对人工智能的担忧日益加剧，甚至一些科技巨头也表示，计算机超级智能的发展需要放慢脚步。 特朗普表示，美国不能输掉与对手中国的技术竞赛，并坚称唯一必要的护栏是“强大而聪明（高智商！）的总统，而美国确实拥有这样的总统！” “人工智能接管世界，摧毁人类，以及所有其他不好的事情，都是一个骗局，”特朗普在他的真相社交网络上关于这个主题的一系列帖子之一中说道。 特朗普将其与他所谓的“所有其他骗局”进行了比较，包括对他的竞选活动与俄罗斯之间关系的调查，以及对乌克兰的弹劾，这两件事都是在他的第一个任期内进行的。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 早些时候，特朗普声称这是针对人工智能的“病态阴谋”，并攻击了反对该技术的“阴谋论者、叛国者、叛徒和泄密者”。 这位美国领导人还猛烈抨击了 Anthropic 首席执行官达里奥·阿莫代 (Dario Amodei) 以及其他公司，后者周六呼吁人工智能公司放慢发展速度。 这位美国总统写道：“特朗普政府已经阻止人工智能‘人’做坏事或可能做坏事，比如达里奥（人类！），他现在假装是一个‘完美的小天使’。” 特朗普将人工智能数据中心作为其经济计划的核心，他质疑为什么人工智能公司想要“将使它们被遗忘和破产”的监管。 他还把矛头指向谷歌，敦促其重新考虑在芬兰投资 150 亿美元（合 210 亿美元）人工智能的计划，他将此归咎于“在美国获得许可太困难”。 但这位 80 岁的共和党人面临着美国选民日益强烈的反对，人们越来越担心人工智能可能通过制造病原体或引发核战争来消灭人类。 大多数美国人还反对耗能的人工智能数据中心，这已成为 11 月份关键的美国中期选举的一个主要问题。 Amodei 的公司 Anthropic 开发了非常成功的人工智能系统 Claude，很快就得到了 OpenAI 老板萨姆·奥尔特曼 (Sam Altman) 和特朗普前盟友埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的支持，后者也拥有 xAI。 OpenAI 开发人员报告了人工智能模型突破本应安全的测试空间、到达互联网并协同攻击存储代码的网站 Hugging Face 的恐慌，引发了最新的警告。 全球担忧...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence presents humanity with unprecedented power, raising profound questions about its potential impact. When leaders dismiss warnings about existential risks, as President Trump did regarding AI, it echoes the ancient story of Babel. There, humanity's unified, ambitious technological project, unchecked by divine...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展赋予人类前所未有的力量，引发了对其潜在影响的深刻质疑。当领导人像特朗普总统那样对人工智能的生存风险发出警告时，这让人联想到古代巴别塔的故事。在那里，人类统一而雄心勃勃的技术项目，在没有神圣智慧的约束下，导致了混乱和分裂。真正的进步不仅需要智慧，还需要谦卑和远见，认识到我们自身理解的局限性以及我们创造物可能带来的后果。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: Arctic power plays: EU searches for a new strategy
title.zh: 北极的权力博弈：欧盟寻求新战略

summary.en: Russia’s aggression, Trump’s threats against Greenland and the race for critical raw materials are pushing the Arctic to the top of Europe’s agenda. The Finnish city of Rovaniemi, known as the "Gateway to the Arctic," hosted a meeting of European leaders to discuss a new EU strategy for the region, driven by climate...
summary.zh: 俄罗斯的侵略、特朗普对格陵兰的威胁以及对关键原材料的争夺，正将北极推到欧洲议程的首位。被称为“北极门户”的芬兰城市罗瓦涅米，接待了欧洲领导人会议，讨论新的欧盟北极战略，其背景是气候变化和乌克兰战争，这些因素已从根本上改变了安全环境，并增加了对欧盟采取行动的需求。

body.en:
Russia’s aggression, Trump’s threats against Greenland and the race for critical raw materials are pushing the Arctic to the top of Europe’s agenda.

Known as the "Gateway to the Arctic ," the Finnish city of Rovaniemi sits directly on the Arctic Circle. Its forests are glowing in autumn colors as European leaders gather here at the invitation of Finnish Prime Minister Petteri Orpo to discuss a new EU strategy for the Arctic. Climate change and Russia’s war against Ukraine have thrust the High North into the center of European attention.

"There is a high demand for concrete EU action in the Arctic," Orpo said. "Our security environment has changed fundamentally. The Arctic has emerged as a central arena of great power competition."

The prime minister added that the Arctic's critical natural resources are also "attracting interest."

The changing security environment was a central theme throughout the summit. EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas warned that Russia is reopening former Soviet military bases in the region and conducting missile exercises in the High North.

"We also see that China is increasingly more interested in the region, so we have to remain vigilant," Kallas said.

The leaders gathered at Finland's northernmost air force base, looking up into a cloudless blue sky as Finnish fighter jets took to the air for a demonstration. Security has been placed at the heart of the discussions by Prime Minister Orpo. From Rovaniemi, Finland's Air Force monitors the skies along Europe's Arctic border with Russia ― 24/7.

German Chancellor Friedrich Merz, who attended despite facing significant political pressure at home, described the region as increasingly important to Europe's security: "This region has become a geopolitical hotspot. Russia is building up its military capabilities here and… uses its presence for hybrid activities every day."

Merz added that the Arctic is not only a security issue, but also offers major economic opportunities, particularly when it comes to critical raw materials.

"From the Putin era onwards, Russia has been developing its military capacities everywhere, but also in the Arctic," said Timo Koivurova of the Arctic Centre at the University of Lapland.

For years Western countries still continued cooperating with Moscow on scientific research and climate issues. Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine brought that era to an end. Finland and Sweden joined NATO as a direct consequence of the war. Finland's 1,340-kilometer border with Russia is now also a NATO border, fundamentally changing the security landscape in northern Europe.

The European Commission plans to update its 2021 Arctic Strategy as early as October 2026. The summit's joint declaration calls for greater investment in military mobility, cross-border...
body.zh: 俄罗斯的侵略、特朗普对格陵兰岛的威胁以及对关键原材料的争夺正在将北极推向欧洲议程的首要位置。 Known as the "Gateway to the Arctic ," the Finnish city of Rovaniemi sits directly on the Arctic Circle.受芬兰总理佩特里·奥尔波邀请，欧洲领导人齐聚这里，讨论欧盟新的北极战略，这里的森林焕发着秋天的色彩。气候变化和俄罗斯对乌克兰的战争使高北地区成为欧洲关注的焦点。 奥尔波说：“欧盟迫切需要在北极采取具体行动。” “我们的安全环境发生了根本性变化。北极已成为大国竞争的中心舞台。” 总理补充说，北极的重要自然资源也“引起了人们的兴趣”。 The changing security environment was a central theme throughout the summit.欧盟外交政策负责人卡亚·卡拉斯警告说，俄罗斯正在重新开放该地区的前苏联军事基地，并在高北地区进行导弹演习。 “我们还看到中国对该地区越来越感兴趣，因此我们必须保持警惕，”卡拉斯说。 各国领导人聚集在芬兰最北端的空军基地，仰望万里无云的蓝天，芬兰战斗机升空进行表演。奥尔波总理将安全问题放在了讨论的核心位置。芬兰空军从罗瓦涅米出发，全天候 (24/7) 监视欧洲与俄罗斯的北极边界沿线的天空。 德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨尽管面临国内巨大的政治压力，仍出席了会议，他形容该地区对欧洲安全越来越重要：“该地区已成为地缘政治热点。俄罗斯正在这里建立军事能力，并且……每天都利用其存在进行混合活动。” 默茨补充说，北极不仅是一个安全问题，而且还提供了重大的经济机会，特别是在关键原材料方面。 拉普兰大学北极中心的蒂莫·科伊乌罗娃表示：“从普京时代开始，俄罗斯一直在各地发展其军事能力，北极也是如此。” 多年来，西方国家仍在科学研究和气候问题上继续与莫斯科合作。俄罗斯对乌克兰的全面入侵结束了那个时代。芬兰和瑞典加入北约是战争的直接后果。芬兰与俄罗斯长达1340公里的边界现在也是北约边界，从根本上改变了北欧的安全格局。 欧盟委员会计划最早于2026年10月更新其2021年北极战略。峰会联合宣言呼吁加大对军事机动性、跨境……的投资。

reflection.en: The Arctic, once a remote frontier, is now a focal point of geopolitical strategy, driven by security concerns and resource competition. As leaders gather to chart a new course, the call for "concrete EU action" underscores the urgency of navigating these complex challenges with wisdom and a commitment to peace. May leaders seek paths that foster stability...
reflection.zh: 北极曾是一个偏远的边疆，如今已成为地缘政治战略的焦点，其驱动力是安全担忧和资源竞争。当领导人聚集在此规划新方向时，“欧盟采取具体行动”的呼吁，凸显了以智慧和对和平的承诺来应对这些复杂挑战的紧迫性。 愿领导人寻求促进稳定与合作的途径，认识到在这个敏感地区追求和平，需要审慎的外交和共同的未来愿景。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Ukraine, Russia set for new round of US-mediated talks
title.zh: 乌克兰、俄罗斯准备进行新一轮美国斡旋会谈

summary.en: New trilateral talks between Ukraine, Russia and the US could begin in October, according to Kyiv and Moscow. Few expect a breakthrough, but Ukraine is seeking a partial de-escalation to help it get through the winter.
summary.zh: 据基辅和莫斯科称，乌克兰、俄罗斯和美国之间的新三边会谈可能于10月开始。尽管很少有人期望取得突破，但乌克兰正寻求部分降级局势，以帮助其度过冬天。

body.en:
New trilateral talks between Ukraine, Russia and the US could begin in October, according to Kyiv and Moscow. Few expect a breakthrough, but Ukraine is seeking a partial de-escalation to help it get through the winter.

Ukraine and Russia have signaled their readiness to resume trilateral talks under US mediation.

"We're preparing. For October," said Kyrylo Budanov, head of the Ukrainian president's office.

Similar signals came from Moscow: "We do not rule out such a possibility. We are talking about the foreseeable future," Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said.

US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner aimed to revive trilateral talks to end Russia's war in Ukraine , visiting Moscow and Kyiv in the first week of September.

The last round of trilateral talks took place in January and February 2026 in Abu Dhabi and Geneva , without producing a breakthrough, as the issue of territory control in eastern Ukraine remained unresolved.

Vladimir Putin still demands more territory than Russia currently controls, Kushner confirmed on September 12, speaking online at the YES security conference in Kyiv.

"President Putin [has] laid out his line of what he wants to achieve. If Ukraine wanted to withdraw to that line, then obviously we have the rest of the deal set up and put together. Ukraine right now does not want to do that," the US envoy said.

The Ukrainian government has indicated it is willing to freeze the fighting along the current frontline in exchange for security guarantees. Such a step could be supported by 60% of Ukrainians, according to a poll by the Kyiv International Institute of Sociology conducted in summer 2026. A similar majority of respondents rejected giving up territory that Russia hasn't been able to conquer. 33% said Ukraine should give up territory that Putin demands.

"For there to be a negotiated end to the war, there has to be parity. Right now, there's a stalemate on the front lines and not much is changing there, but in the air war, unfortunately, Russia currently has a significant advantage," Volodymyr Fesenko, a Kyiv-based political scientist, told DW. 

Ukraine is running low on interceptors for Russian ballistic missiles. Russia has also stepped up attacks with new jet-powered drones, which fly faster than older gasoline-powered models and are harder to intercept.

Russian airstrikes are increasingly targeting Ukraine's economy, including warehouses, energy facilities, gas stations and railway infrastructure.

The Kremlin has accused Ukraine of opening a "Pandora's box" by targeting Russia's economy and fuel and energy facilities with deep strikes since the summer. Ukraine says the attacks are intended to force Russia to the negotiating table.

"The escalation ... is not a problem. It's a sign of...
body.zh: 据基辅和莫斯科称，乌克兰、俄罗斯和美国之间的新三边会谈可能于十月开始。很少有人预计会取得突破，但乌克兰正在寻求部分缓和局势以帮助其度过冬天。 乌克兰和俄罗斯已表示愿意在美国的调解下恢复三边会谈。 乌克兰总统办公室主任基里洛·布达诺夫(Kyrylo Budanov)表示：“我们正在为十月份做准备。” 莫斯科也发出了类似的信号：“我们不排除这种可能性。我们正在谈论可预见的未来，”克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫说。 美国特使史蒂夫·威特科夫（Steve Witkoff）和贾里德·库什纳（Jared Kushner）旨在重启三边会谈，以结束俄罗斯在乌克兰的战争，他们于九月的第一周访问了莫斯科和基辅。 上一轮三边会谈于2026年1月和2026年2月在阿布扎比和日内瓦举行，但由于乌克兰东部领土控制问题仍未解决，未能取得突破。 库什纳 9 月 12 日在基辅举行的 YES 安全会议上在线发表讲话时证实，弗拉基米尔·普京仍然要求获得比俄罗斯目前控制的更多的领土。 “普京总统已经制定了他想要实现的目标。如果乌克兰想撤回这条线，那么显然我们已经制定并整合了协议的其余部分。乌克兰现在不想这样做，”美国特使说。 乌克兰政府表示愿意冻结当前前线的战斗，以换取安全保障。根据基辅国际社会学研究所 2026 年夏季进行的一项民意调查，这一举措可能会得到 60% 的乌克兰人的支持。类似的大多数受访者拒绝放弃俄罗斯尚未征服的领土。 33%的人表示乌克兰应该放弃普京要求的领土。 基辅政治学家弗拉基米尔·费先科(Volodymyr Fesenko)告诉德国之声：“要通过谈判结束战争，就必须实现对等。目前，前线陷入僵局，没有太大变化，但不幸的是，在空战中，俄罗斯目前拥有显着优势。” 乌克兰的俄罗斯弹道导弹拦截器所剩无几。俄罗斯还加大了新型喷气式无人机的攻击力度，这种无人机比老式汽油动力无人机飞行速度更快，而且更难拦截。 俄罗斯空袭越来越多地针对乌克兰经济，包括仓库、能源设施、加油站和铁路基础设施。 克里姆林宫指责乌克兰自夏季以来对俄罗斯经济以及燃料和能源设施进行深度打击，打开了“潘多拉魔盒”。乌克兰表示，这些袭击旨在迫使俄罗斯坐到谈判桌前。 “升级……不是问题。这是……的迹象。”

reflection.en: As Ukraine and Russia signal readiness for new US-mediated talks, the pursuit of peace, even amidst deep conflict and low expectations, is a vital step. Romans 12:18 reminds us to 'live in peace with everyone, as much as it is possible.' These diplomatic efforts, however tentative, embody that call to actively seek peace.
reflection.zh: 随着乌克兰和俄罗斯表示愿意进行美国斡旋的新一轮会谈，对和平的追求，即使在深层冲突和低期望的背景下，也是至关重要的一步。罗马书12:18提醒我们“务要随众人和睦”。这些外交努力，无论多么初步，都体现了积极寻求和平的呼召。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Trump seeks halt to energy attacks by both Russia, Ukraine
title.zh: 特朗普寻求俄乌停止袭击能源目标

summary.en: Former US President Donald Trump claimed on Monday that Russia and Ukraine have agreed to cease striking energy targets, a move he said would help lower US diesel prices. Ukraine responded cautiously, stating they await specifics from partners, while Russia has not commented. This claim comes amid ongoing, largely...
summary.zh: 美国前总统唐纳德·特朗普周一声称，俄罗斯和乌克兰已同意停止袭击能源目标，他表示此举将有助于降低美国的柴油价格。乌克兰反应谨慎，表示正在等待合作伙伴的具体细节，而俄罗斯尚未置评。这一说法是在美国斡旋的谈判基本停滞不前之际提出的。

body.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普因美国创纪录的柴油价格而受到批评，他声称俄罗斯和乌克兰已同意停止实施能源目标。俄罗斯什么也没说； Ukraine said "we expect specifics from our partners" on any such move. US President Donald Trump claimed a breakthrough on Monday in diplomacy between Ukraine and Russia , although his unsubstantiated declaration only elicited a very reserved comment from Ukraine and no immediate word from the Kremlin. The assertion comes amid indications from both Russia and Ukraine that they would be willing to continue with US-brokered negotiations , which have been largely stagnant throughout Trump's second term. 乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基上周告诉德国之声，如果有关普京受邀的传闻成为现实，他愿意在12月迈阿密G20峰会上与俄罗斯总统普京会面。 特朗普似乎声称乌克兰和俄罗斯已同意停止实现彼此的能源目标。 “乌克兰已同意不攻击俄罗斯能源目标。俄罗斯也同意这样做！”特朗普或他的团队写道。 "The World's Diesel price is mostly caused by the Russia/Ukraine War [sic], not Iran," the Truth Social comment continued, demonstrating — as a quickfire series of agitated follow-up posts would reinforce — a desire to downplay rising US oil prices, the role of Trump's war in Iran in pushing them skywards, and economic pressures closer to home. Ukraine's presidency declined to comment but President Volodymyr Zelenskyy issued a more guarded statement online. He did, however, say that he had recommended seeking such an accord, as winter approaches — if Russia's cooperation could be ensured after years of it targeting Ukrainian energy infrastructure. 泽连斯基在网上写道：“乌克兰已提议其合作伙伴与俄罗斯达成协议，以停止破坏关键基础设施。” “粮食、能源和其他维持生命的基本物资必须受到保护，俄罗斯的打击主要针对它们。” 但泽连斯基警告说，如果能够达成协议，基辅“不相信俄罗斯愿意遵守协议”。 “如果我们的合作伙伴准备好确保俄罗斯真正避免袭击我们的电力系统、其他能源设施、关键基础设施和食品供应路线，那么我们当然也准备好确保相应停止我们的袭击。” 他表示，基辅需要确保这是一项持久的协议，而不仅仅是为了在本周末的选举前暂时缓解俄罗斯的燃油价格。 泽连斯基总结道：“我们期待合作伙伴提供具体信息。”但他没有点名。 As Trump's war in Iran pushed oil prices...

reflection.en: In the midst of ongoing conflict, any reported step toward de-escalation offers a glimmer of hope. The pursuit of peace, even through unconfirmed claims, highlights the deep human longing for an end to hostilities. May all parties involved find the wisdom and will to pursue lasting peace.
reflection.zh: 在持续的冲突中，任何关于缓和局势的报道都带来一丝希望。对和平的追求，即使是通过未经证实的主张，也凸显了人类对停止敌对行动的深切渴望。愿所有相关方都能找到智慧和意愿，追求持久的和平。

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

title.en: Immigrants held in small outdoor cages at 'Alligator Alcatraz' in Florida, investigators find
title.zh: 调查人员发现佛罗里达州“鳄鱼恶魔岛”的移民被关在露天笼子里

summary.en: DHS inspectors say they found the immigration-detention centre violated basic standards for hygiene, medical care, food and safety.
summary.zh: 美国国土安全部检查人员表示，他们发现该移民拘留中心违反了卫生、医疗、食品和安全的基本标准。

body.en:
Immigrants held at "Alligator Alcatraz", a now-shuttered detention centre in Florida, were kept in small metal cages for hours, according to a report from the US Department of Homeland Security's watchdog.

The Office of the Inspector General (OIG) found the use of the outdoor cages - about 18sq ft (1.67sq m) - was "unprecedented among detention facilities" and dangerous.

Investigators concluded the centre also did not comply with a number of standards for hygiene, medical care, food, health and safety.

The BBC has contacted DHS's Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and Florida Governor Ron DeSantis for comment. DHS told the watchdog that state officials ran the facility.

In its response included in the investigation report, DHS officials said Florida - not the federal government - had authority over day-to-day operations at the facility.

The facility was established by the state of Florida through an executive order signed by DeSantis, but the federal government paid for operational costs.

In January, the OIG conducted a surprise inspection at the detention facility, which had become one of the most notorious immigration detention centres in the US. The OIG is an independent internal watchdog at DHS. The current inspector general was appointed by President Donald Trump during his first term.

In 2025, the detention facility was built over the course of eight days in the Everglades, a protected wetland known for its alligators. Trump once joked that immigrants held there would need to learn "how to run away" from the reptiles at the facility, which civil rights groups have decried as inhumane.

In June 2026, DeSantis said the facility would close as it was only meant to be temporary.

According to the OIG report, between July 2025 and January 2026, the facility kept 79 immigrants in the small metal enclosures, describing them as "calming areas" for people to "deescalate and have time alone". They were held there from periods ranging from minutes to nearly two hours, at least once as a disciplinary measure, OIG said.

"The use of such restrictive spaces is highly unconventional and does not align with standards for humane treatment," the report stated.

Detainees at the facility have previously told the BBC they were denied necessary medication and regular showers and other hygiene measures.

In their report, OIG inspectors said they found immigrants held at the facility had to use showers infested with small bugs and were only allowed to do so three times a week.

The facility did not provide them with sufficient living space, "creating cramped conditions for detainees who spent most of their time in their housing units", according to the report.

Immigrants at the centre also told OIG that they did not have access to clean drinking water...
body.zh: 根据美国国土安全部监管机构的一份报告，被关押在佛罗里达州“鳄鱼恶魔岛”拘留中心（现已关闭）的移民被关在小金属笼子里几个小时。 监察长办公室 (OIG) 发现，户外笼子的使用面积约为 18 平方英尺（1.67 平方米），“在拘留设施中是史无前例的”，而且很危险。 调查人员得出的结论是，该中心也不符合卫生、医疗、食品、健康和安全方面的多项标准。 BBC 已联系国土安全部移民和海关执法局 (ICE) 以及佛罗里达州州长罗恩·德桑蒂斯征求意见。国土安全部告诉监管机构，该设施由州政府官员运营。 国土安全部官员在调查报告中的回应中表示，佛罗里达州而非联邦政府对该设施的日常运营拥有权力。 该设施是由佛罗里达州通过德桑蒂斯签署的行政命令建立的，但联邦政府支付运营费用。 一月份，监察办对拘留设施进行了突击检查，该设施已成为美国最臭名昭著的移民拘留中心之一。监察办是国土安全部的一个独立内部监督机构。现任监察长是由唐纳德·特朗普总统在其第一任期内任命的。 2025 年，拘留设施在八天内建成，位于大沼泽地，这是一片以鳄鱼而闻名的受保护湿地。特朗普曾开玩笑说，被关押在那里的移民需要学习“如何逃离”该设施中的爬行动物，民权组织谴责这些爬行动物是不人道的。 2026 年 6 月，德桑蒂斯表示该设施将关闭，因为它只是暂时的。 根据监察长办公室的报告，2025 年 7 月至 2026 年 1 月期间，该设施将 79 名移民关在小型金属围栏内，并将其描述为“平静区域”，供人们“降温并享受独处时间”。监察办表示，他们被关押在那里的时间从几分钟到近两个小时不等，至少有一次作为纪律措施。 报告指出：“这种限制性空间的使用是非常规的，也不符合人道待遇的标准。” 该设施中的被拘留者此前告诉英国广播公司，他们被剥夺了必要的药物、定期淋浴和其他卫生措施。 监察办检查人员在报告中表示，他们发现被关押在该设施的移民必须使用充满小虫子的淋浴，并且每周只允许这样做三次。 报告称，该设施没有为他们提供足够的生活空间，“为被拘留者创造了狭窄的条件，他们大部分时间都呆在自己的住房里”。 Immigrants at the centre also told OIG that they did not have access to clean drinking water...

reflection.en: The report from the US Department of Homeland Security's watchdog details immigrants held in small, outdoor metal cages at a Florida detention center, violating basic standards of care. This situation cries out for advocacy, reminding us of the call to 'speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves' and to defend the rights of the vulnerable.
reflection.zh: 美国国土安全部监察长的报告详细说明了移民被关在佛罗里达州拘留中心的小型露天金属笼子里，违反了基本的护理标准。这种情况亟需倡导，提醒我们“为那些不能为自己说话的人说话”并捍卫弱势群体的权利。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Africa's richest man launches continent's biggest share sale
title.zh: 非洲首富启动非洲最大规模股票发行

summary.en: Nigerian billionaire Aliko Dangote has launched the largest share sale in Africa, offering a stake in his oil refinery to the public. The move aims to allow ordinary Nigerians to share in the success of the refinery, which began production in 2024 and supplies over 70% of Nigeria's energy consumption.
summary.zh: 尼日利亚亿万富翁阿里科·丹戈特（Aliko Dangote）已启动非洲规模最大的股票发行，向公众出售其炼油厂的股份。此举旨在让普通尼日利亚人分享该炼油厂的成功，该炼油厂于2024年开始生产，供应着尼日利亚超过70%的能源消耗。

body.en:
Nigerian billionaire Aliko Dangote has launched Africa's largest ever share sale, offering a stake in his oil refinery to the general public in a deal that could raise as much as $2.1bn (£1.6bn).

The initial public offering (IPO) is for roughly 3% of the Dangote refinery, with the billionaire saying he wanted to give ordinary Nigerians the chance to share in the plant's success.

The refinery, which started production in 2024, is one of the largest in the world and took more than a decade to complete.

It now supplies more than 70% of Nigeria's energy consumption, and many Nigerians have expressed excitement at the prospect of owning a part of it.

Among them is Isah Salisu, who told the BBC he withdrew 50,000 naira (£28; $37) from his savings to invest.

"My hope is that my small money will one day grow big. I don't want to miss out as many I know are also investing," he said.

The IPO lasts for a month and the minimum purchase is 10 shares, costing about $4.

Economy and business expert Dr Abdulrazak Ibrahim Fagge told the BBC that Monday's event was historic.

But he warned investors that the price of the shares could fall, meaning people could lose some of their money.

"What prospective buyers, especially first-time buyers, should know is that they shouldn't invest all their money or money they would need in a couple of months," he said.

"They should invest something they could do without for the next three, four, five years."

He also warned people to be wary of scammers, saying there are people who would want to take advantage of those without good knowledge of the process.

"I will advise people to only deal with the institutions that have been listed," he said.

Nigeria is Africa's biggest oil producer but until the refinery was opened, most of the country's fuel had to be imported because of a lack of refining capacity in the country.

Born in Kano, Dangote, 67, has a net worth of around $28bn, according to Forbes magazine.

He made his fortune in cement and sugar in Nigeria before expanding to 16 other African countries.

The Lagos refinery was first announced in 2013 with an initial estimated cost of around $19bn, but construction did not begin until 2017. It was further delayed by the Covid-19 pandemic.

The site, in the Lekki Free Zone near Lagos, required massive land reclamation, with 65 million cubic metres of sand moved.

The refinery has a processing capacity of 650,000 barrels per day, making it the seventh-largest in the world.
body.zh: 尼日利亚亿万富翁阿利科·丹格特 (Aliko Dangote) 启动了非洲有史以来最大规模的股票出售，向公众出售其炼油厂的股份，这笔交易可能筹集高达 21 亿美元（16 亿英镑）的资金。 此次首次公开募股 (IPO) 涉及丹格特炼油厂约 3% 的股份，这位亿万富翁表示，他希望让普通尼日利亚人有机会分享该工厂的成功。 该炼油厂于 2024 年开始生产，是世界上最大的炼油厂之一，历时十多年才建成。 现在它供应尼日利亚70%以上的能源消耗，许多尼日利亚人对拥有其中一部分的前景表示兴奋。 其中包括伊萨·萨利苏 (Isah Salisu)，他告诉 BBC，他从储蓄中提取了 50,000 奈拉（28 英镑；37 美元）用于投资。 “我希望我的小钱有一天会变大。我不想错过很多我认识的人也在投资，”他说。 IPO持续一个月，最低申购数量为10股，成本约为4美元。 经济和商业专家阿卜杜勒拉扎克·易卜拉欣·法格博士告诉英国广播公司，周一的活动具有历史意义。 但他警告投资者，股价可能会下跌，这意味着人们可能会损失一些钱。 他说：“潜在买家，尤其是首次购房者，应该知道的是，他们不应该将所有资金或几个月内所需的资金投入其中。” “他们应该投资一些他们在未来三、四年、五年内不需要的东西。” 他还警告人们要警惕诈骗者，并表示有些人会想利用那些不了解整个过程的人。 “我建议人们只与已列出的机构打交道，”他说。 尼日利亚是非洲最大的石油生产国，但在炼油厂开业之前，由于该国缺乏炼油能力，该国大部分燃料都必须进口。 据《福布斯》杂志报道，67 岁的丹格特出生于卡诺，拥有约 280 亿美元的净资产。 他在尼日利亚靠水泥和糖业发家致富，随后扩展到其他 16 个非洲国家。 拉各斯炼油厂于 2013 年首次宣布，最初估计成本约为 190 亿美元，但直到 2017 年才开始建设。由于 Covid-19 大流行，建设进一步推迟。 该地点位于拉各斯附近的莱基自由区，需要进行大规模土地开垦，搬运了 6500 万立方米的沙子。 该炼油厂的加工能力为每天 65 万桶，位居世界第七。

reflection.en: Aliko Dangote's initiative to offer shares in his oil refinery to ordinary Nigerians reflects a desire to broaden the base of economic participation. This venture, a decade in the making, represents a significant undertaking where success is entrusted to future market reception and operational excellence. It echoes the wisdom of committing one's endeavors...
reflection.zh: 阿里科·丹戈特（Aliko Dangote）将石油炼油厂的股份提供给普通尼日利亚人的举措，体现了扩大经济参与基础的愿望。这项历时十年才完成的事业，代表着一项重大工程，其成功寄托于未来的市场接受度和卓越运营。这呼应了将人的努力托付于更高力量、寻求工作指导和祝福的智慧。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Flash flooding interrupts half-marathon, submerges cars
title.zh: 洪水突袭半程马拉松，汽车被淹

summary.en: Parts of New York, New Jersey and Connecticut were hit by flash flooding, leading to water rescues, stranded motorists and half-marathon runners battling the floodwaters. Connecticut officials said parts of the state saw up to seven inches of rain in a very short period of time, according to the BBC's partner, CBS...
summary.zh: 纽约、新泽西和康涅狄格州的部分地区遭遇了山洪暴发，导致了水上救援、车辆滞留以及半程马拉松选手在洪水中艰难前行。据英国广播公司（BBC）的合作伙伴CBS新闻报道，康涅狄格州官员称该州部分地区在极短时间内降雨量高达七英寸。

body.en: Parts of New York, New Jersey and Connecticut were hit by flash flooding leading to water rescues, stranded motorists and half-marathon runners struggling through waist-deep flood waters. Connecticut officials said parts of the state saw up to seven inches of rain in a very short period of time, according to the BBC's partner, CBS News.
body.zh: 纽约、新泽西和康涅狄格州部分地区遭受山洪袭击，导致水上救援、被困的驾车者和半程马拉松运动员在齐腰深的洪水中挣扎。据 BBC 合作伙伴哥伦比亚广播公司新闻报道，康涅狄格州官员表示，该州部分地区在很短的时间内降雨量高达 7 英寸。

reflection.en: The sudden and intense flash flooding in New York, New Jersey, and Connecticut brought chaos and danger, submerging cars and forcing runners to battle waist-deep water. In moments of overwhelming natural disaster, when the earth itself seems to shift, we are reminded that Yahweh is our refuge and strength, a help readily found in times of distress. May...
reflection.zh: 纽约、新泽西和康涅狄格州突如其来的强烈山洪暴发带来了混乱和危险，淹没了汽车，迫使跑者在齐腰深的水中艰难前行。在压倒性的自然灾害面前，当大地似乎都在动摇时，我们被提醒雅伟是我们的避难所和力量，是在患难中随时可得的帮助。 愿受影响的人们找到安全并迅速恢复。面对如此强大的力量，我们可以转向神圣的慰藉和力量，即使脚下的土地不稳定，也能信靠那依然坚定的存在。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Body of missing runner found in South Africa
title.zh: 失踪跑步者遗体在南非被发现

summary.en: A nationwide appeal was launched after Elizabeth Moselakgomo went missing last week. Her body was identified on Monday. She is one of five women whose bodies have been found in the Kempton Park area, east of Johannesburg, with police issuing a public warning due to the concerning similarities.
summary.zh: 上周伊丽莎白·莫塞拉科莫失踪后，全国发起了搜寻呼吁。她的遗体于周一被确认。她是东兰德约翰内斯堡地区肯普顿公园地区发现的五名女性遗体中的一人，警方因令人担忧的相似之处发出了公众警告。

body.en:
South African police have confirmed the death of a jogger, who went missing during a routine run last week, sparking a nationwide appeal for help finding her.

The body of Elizabeth Moselakgomo was identified by her relatives on Monday after it was discovered east of Johannesburg on Saturday. She is one of five women whose bodies have been found half-naked and bruised in the same area, Kempton Park.

Police said they were not linking the deaths to a serial killer but added that the "similarities are sufficiently concerning… to issue a public warning".

A jogger who knew Moselakgomo through their running club told the BBC the discovery of the five bodies was "very scary".

"It's sad to know that every woman in South Africa… can't just go outside. You can't just go to the shop and buy flowers… because you are always in danger," said Keamo Sefularo.

Police have urged women in the Kempton Park area to avoid walking or running alone "particularly in isolated areas".

South Africa experiences some of the world's highest levels of gender-based violence (GBV), with the rate at which women are killed five times higher than the global average, according to UN Women.

Moselakgomo's body was found on Saturday night, badly bruised and partially clothed.

Just hours earlier on Monday, another woman's half-naked body was found about 25km (15 miles) away.

The latest discovery was made by a passer-by, who spotted the body on his way to work, police spokesperson Brig Athlenda Mathe told reporters at the scene.

One arrest has been made in connection with the discovery of the first body. The person is still in police custody.

The police have since set up a task team to investigate the murders but these grim discoveries and Moselakgomo's death have sparked renewed outrage and fear among South Africans.

Tributes poured in for the avid runner, affectionately known as "Tsontso" after police confirmed her death. South Africans also shared the fear and anxiety women often feel in the country.

Lesedi Ledwaba, in a post on X, said: "Women are not free if we have to calculate where, when and with whom we can walk, run or exist safely".

This was echoed by Sefularo, who said Moselakgomo's disappearance had been "heavy for the club".

The 29-year-old also asked whether Moselakgomo would "still be here if maybe she had a small community to run with [or] one or three people"?

"As we always say, when we go out for runs, there's safety in numbers," she reflected.

Sefularo shared the measures she often took to keep safe while running, including avoiding taking the same route each day and making sure she ran in areas with good visibility.

Advocacy group Women for Change said the discovery of these bodies was angering.

"What is the purpose of having a protective service like...
body.zh: 南非警方证实了一名慢跑者的死亡，这名慢跑者在上周的例行跑步中失踪，引发了全国范围内寻求帮助寻找她的呼吁。 伊丽莎白·莫塞拉科莫的尸体于周六在约翰内斯堡东部被发现，周一由她的亲属确认身份。她是在肯普顿公园同一地区被发现的五名半裸、遍体鳞伤的女性之一。 警方表示，他们并未将这些死亡事件与连环杀手联系起来，但补充说，“这些相似之处足以令人担忧……需要发出公开警告”。 一位通过跑步俱乐部认识莫塞拉克莫的慢跑者告诉英国广播公司，发现五具尸体“非常可怕”。 “令人遗憾的是，南非的每个女性......都不能出去。你不能只是去商店买花......因为你总是处于危险之中，”Keamo Sefularo 说。 警方敦促肯普顿公园地区的妇女避免独自行走或跑步，“尤其是在偏僻地区”。 据联合国妇女署称，南非是世界上性别暴力（GBV）最严重的国家之一，妇女被杀的比率是全球平均水平的五倍。 莫塞拉科莫的尸体于周六晚上被发现，身上伤痕累累，衣服也只剩下部分衣服。 就在周一几个小时前，另一名女性半裸尸体在约 25 公里（15 英里）外被发现。 警方发言人布里格·阿特伦达·马特在现场告诉记者，最新的发现是一名路人在上班途中发现了尸体。 因发现第一具尸体而逮捕了一名人员。该人仍被警方拘留。 此后，警方成立了一个工作组来调查这起谋杀案，但这些可怕的发现和莫塞拉科莫的死亡再次引发了南非人的愤怒和恐惧。 警方确认她死亡后，人们纷纷向这位狂热的跑步者表示哀悼，人们亲切地称她为“Tsontso”。南非人也和该国女性一样感到恐惧和焦虑。 Lesedi Ledwaba 在 X 上的一篇帖子中表示：“如果我们必须计算我们可以在哪里、何时以及与谁一起安全地行走、跑步或生存，那么女性就不自由”。 塞夫拉罗对此表示赞同，他表示莫塞拉科莫的失踪“对俱乐部来说是沉重的打击”。 这位 29 岁的年轻人还问，莫塞拉科莫“如果她有一个小社区可以和一三个人一起经营的话，她是否还会在这里”？ “正如我们常说的，当我们出去跑步时，人多才安全，”她反思道。 Sefularo 分享了她在跑步时经常采取的确保安全的措施，包括避免每天走同一条路线，并确保在能见度良好的区域跑步。 倡导组织“女性变革”表示，这些尸体的发现令人愤怒。 “提供像这样的保护服务的目的是什么......

reflection.en: The discovery of Elizabeth Moselakgomo's body, alongside four other women in the Kempton Park area, is a tragic reminder of the violence that can prey on the vulnerable. The prophet Isaiah's call to 'learn to do good; seek justice, correct oppression; bring relief to the oppressed, give justice to the fatherless, plead for the widow' speaks to the deep...
reflection.zh: 伊丽莎白·莫塞拉科莫的遗体在约翰内斯堡以东的肯普顿公园地区与其他四名女性的遗体一同被发现，这令人悲痛地提醒我们，弱势群体可能遭受的暴力。先知以赛亚呼吁“你们要学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的，给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇争辩”，这呼应了人类对安全和保护的深切需求，尤其是对那些最处于危险中的人。

verse.textEn: Learn to do right; seek justice. Defend the oppressed. Take up the cause of the fatherless; plead the case of the widow.
verse.textZh: 学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的；给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇辨屈。

title.en: IPO 'for the people' is out of reach for many in Nigeria
title.zh: “人民的”首次公开募股对尼日利亚许多人来说遥不可及

summary.en: Dangote seeks $1.6 billion from investors to finance a $14.3 billion expansion and thus double the oil refinery's capacity. The offer could give millions of Nigerians a stake in the company. But who can truly afford it?
summary.zh: 丹格特寻求投资者16亿美元，为其143亿美元的扩张融资，从而使炼油厂的产能翻倍。此次发行可能使数百万尼日利亚人获得该公司股份。但谁又能真正负担得起呢？

body.en:
Dangote seeks $1.6 billion from investors to finance a $14.3 billion expansion and thus double the oil refinery's capacity. The offer could give millions of Nigerians a stake in the company. But who can truly afford it?

The industrialist Aliko Dangote is turning to Nigerians to help finance the next growth phase of his oil refinery: The richest man in Africa announced that he is seeking to attract about $1.6 billion (€1.4 billion) by going public.

This initial public offering of Dangote Industries is intended to help support a $14.3 billion expansion, which would more than double the refinery's production capacity. In absolute numbers, it would increase capacity from 700,000 barrels per day (bpd) to 1.4 million bpd.

It would also include new petrochemical and refining units designed to reduce Nigeria 's reliance on imports of some petrochemical products while also allowing the plant to produce different grades of diesel.

This plan would make the refinery one of the largest single-site refining complexes in the world.

Dangote's ambitious plans also include the launch of a processing plant in Kenya to extend his reach from the Atlantic to the Indian Ocean, which is planned to be launched in partnership with governments in eastern Africa.

Since it began operations in 2024, the Dangote Petroleum Refinery has started to reshape Nigeria's fuel market, and has become one of the few businesses in the world to benefit from the ongoing supply disruptions caused by the war in Iran.

The refinery has become an important supplier of petrol and other fuels domestically and abroad; in fact, it made Nigeria a net exporter of refined fuel for the first time after reaching its full capacity in early 2026.

The refinery reported making an after-tax profit of $1.82 ​billion in the first half ​of 2026, following ⁠a $476 million loss for all of 2025.

Things appear to be on the up-and-up for Dangote — so, why is the company seeking public investment now?

Ayodele Oni, an energy analyst and partner with the Bloomfield Law Practice in Lagos, told DW that the public offering could be a "game changer," as it alters the role of who could stand to benefit from Dangote's expansion drive.

Oni said equity invested by potentially millions of Nigerian and international shareholders would shield the corporation from having to rely solely on expensive dollar debt "with permanent Naira capital, which matches a business now earning heavily in Naira."

This could also unlock additional long-term investment as any "listed company answers to ... its shareholders every quarter." "That transparency is precisely what long-term lenders and international partners want to see before the next billion is committed," Oni said.

He said this would turn into a sustainable model for...
body.zh: 丹格特向投资者寻求 16 亿美元的资金，以资助 ​​143 亿美元的扩建，从而将炼油厂的产能提高一倍。该报价可能会让数百万尼日利亚人获得该公司的股份。但谁能真正负担得起呢？ 实业家阿利科·丹格特 (Aliko Dangote) 正在向尼日利亚人寻求帮助，为他的炼油厂下一阶段的发展提供资金：这位非洲首富宣布，他正在寻求通过上市吸引约 16 亿美元（14 亿欧元）的资金。 Dangote Industries 的此次首次公开募股旨在帮助支持 143 亿美元的扩张，这将使炼油厂的产能增加一倍以上。从绝对数字来看，产能将从 70 万桶/日增加到 140 万桶/日。 它还将包括新的石化和炼油装置，旨在减少尼日利亚对某些石化产品进口的依赖，同时允许该工厂生产不同等级的柴油。 该计划将使该炼油厂成为世界上最大的单一炼油厂之一。 丹格特雄心勃勃的计划还包括在肯尼亚建立一家加工厂，将其业务范围从大西洋扩展到印度洋，该工厂计划与东非各国政府合作启动。 自2024年开始运营以来，丹格特炼油厂开始重塑尼日利亚的燃料市场，并成为世界上少数受益于伊朗战争造成的持续供应中断的企业之一。 炼油厂已成为国内外汽油及其他燃料的重要供应商；事实上，这使尼日利亚在 2026 年初达到满负荷生产后首次成为精炼燃料净出口国。 该炼油厂报告称，2026 年上半年实现税后利润 18.2 亿美元，而 2025 年全年亏损 4.76 亿美元。 丹格特的情况似乎正在好转——那么，为什么该公司现在寻求公共投资呢？ 拉各斯布卢姆菲尔德律师事务所合伙人、能源分析师阿约德勒·奥尼 (Ayodele Oni) 告诉德国之声，此次公开发行可能会“改变游戏规则”，因为它改变了谁可以从丹格特扩张计划中受益。 奥尼表示，潜在的数百万尼日利亚和国际股东投资的股权将使该公司不必完全依赖昂贵的美元债务，“拥有永久的奈拉资本，这与目前在奈拉赚取巨额利润的企业相匹配”。 这还可以释放额外的长期投资，因为任何“上市公司每个季度都会对其股东做出回应”。奥尼表示：“这种透明度正是长期贷款机构和国际合作伙伴在承诺下一个十亿资金之前希望看到的。” 他说这将成为一个可持续的模式......

reflection.en: This news about Dangote's refinery expansion and its initial public offering (IPO) raises questions about economic fairness. While the goal is to offer shares to millions of Nigerians, the substantial investment required may place it out of reach for many. The proverb "Yahweh detests dishonest scales, but accurate weights are his delight" speaks to the...
reflection.zh: 关于丹格特炼油厂扩张及其首次公开募股（IPO）的新闻，引发了对经济公平的疑问。虽然目标是向数百万尼日利亚人提供股份，但所需的大笔投资可能使许多人望而却步。《雅伟憎恶欺诈的天平，但公平的砝码是他的喜悦》这句箴言，强调了在包括金融市场在内的所有交易中，诚信和公平的重要性，确保机会真正惠及大众，而不仅仅是少数特权人士。

verse.textEn: Yahweh detests dishonest scales, but accurate weights find favor with him.
verse.textZh: 诡诈的天平为雅伟所憎恶；公平的法码为他所喜悦。

title.en: A 'winner-takes-all race' that could end in catastrophe, and the calls to slow it down
title.zh: 一场可能导致灾难的“赢者通吃”竞赛，以及要求放缓的呼声

summary.en: Frontier AI companies are raising alarms about the rapid pace of their own industry's development, with leaders calling for a slowdown to implement better safety measures and guardrails.
summary.zh: 世界前沿的人工智能公司正在对自身行业的发展速度敲响警钟，领导者们呼吁放缓步伐，以实施更完善的安全措施和保障措施。

body.en:
It sounds like science fiction — or the stuff of nightmares — as some of the biggest names in artificial intelligence warn that the technology their own companies are developing could go seriously wrong without an urgent slowdown.

Over the weekend, Anthropic boss Dario Amodei published an online essay calling for a coordinated reduction in the pace of AI development in order to give companies and governments more time to establish better guardrails.

While those concerns have existed for years, Amodei said events in recent months — including the Hugging Face AI hacking incident — had convinced him that action was needed.

Some experts have described that incident as a wake-up call that provided a concrete demonstration of the safety risks they had long warned about.

Amodei reportedly left industry giant Open AI over ethical concerns and co-founded Anthropic, another large US AI company that operates the popular Claude chatbot.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"I believe that if slowing down bought us even an extra year or two before models reach critical levels of capability, and we used that time to advance alignment, we could greatly reduce the risk that something goes seriously wrong," Amodei wrote.

Key among Amodei's concerns was so-called "recursive self-improvement", where AI becomes capable of improving AI, potentially creating a cycle of increasingly powerful systems that outrun human ability to understand or control them.

The leaders of two rival AI companies, OpenAI's Sam Altman and xAI's Elon Musk, both voiced their agreement.

Alarm about the potentially existential risks posed by AI grew after an Anthropic researcher resigned last week, stating that "people building AI earnestly believe that it could kill us all by the end of the decade".

If some of the industry's biggest players agree that AI development should slow down, what would that look like — and is it even possible?

It depends who you ask. United States President Donald Trump brushed off calls to check the development of AI and suggestions that the technology is moving too quickly, attributing those warnings to "negative forces".

"We're leading China on AI ... and, frankly, I want to keep it that way because whoever wins AI, wins," he said over the weekend.

Experts say AI leaders may be genuinely concerned about the technology's consequences, yet they are also motivated to rapidly advance out of fear their competitors will outpace them.

body.zh: 这听起来像是科幻小说，或者是噩梦，因为人工智能领域的一些知名人士警告说，如果不紧急放慢速度，他们自己公司正在开发的技术可能会出现严重错误。 周末，Anthropic 老板达里奥·阿莫迪 (Dario Amodei) 在网上发表了一篇文章，呼吁协调一致地放慢人工智能的发展速度，以便给企业和政府更多的时间来建立更好的护栏。 尽管这些担忧已经存在多年，但阿莫迪表示，最近几个月发生的事件——包括 Hugging Face AI 黑客事件——让他确信需要采取行动。 一些专家将这一事件描述为一记警钟，具体展示了他们长期以来警告的安全风险。 据报道，Amodei 因道德问题离开了行业巨头 Open AI，并与他人共同创立了另一家美国大型人工智能公司 Anthropic，该公司运营广受欢迎的 Claude 聊天机器人。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 阿莫迪写道：“我相信，如果放慢速度，让我们在模型达到关键能力水平之前多花一两年的时间，并且我们利用这段时间来推进调整，我们就可以大大降低出现严重错误的风险。” 阿莫迪担心的关键是所谓的“递归自我改进”，即人工智能能够改进人工智能，有可能创造一个日益强大的系统的循环，超出人类理解或控制它们的能力。 两家竞争对手人工智能公司的领导人 OpenAI 的 Sam Altman 和 xAI 的 Elon Musk 都表示同意。 上周，一位人类研究人员辞职后，人们对人工智能带来的潜在生存风险的警觉越来越强烈，他表示“构建人工智能的人们真诚地相信，到本世纪末，它可能会杀死我们所有人”。 如果该行业的一些最大参与者同意人工智能发展应该放缓，那会是什么样子——这有可能吗？ 这取决于你问谁。美国总统唐纳德·特朗普对检查人工智能发展的呼吁以及该技术发展太快的建议不予理睬，将这些警告归因于“负面力量”。 他周末表示：“我们在人工智能方面领先中国……坦率地说，我希望保持这种状态，因为谁赢得了人工智能，谁就获胜了。” 专家表示，人工智能领导者可能真正担心该技术的后果，但他们也担心竞争对手会超过他们，因此也有动力快速前进。 莫纳什大学数据科学与人工智能系的澳大利亚获奖者杰夫·韦伯 (Geoff Webb) 告诉 SBS 新闻，他认为人工智能公司“遥不可及”……

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence, described as a 'winner-takes-all race,' carries echoes of the Tower of Babel story. In Genesis 11, humanity's unified ambition to reach the heavens led to divine intervention and confusion. Today's AI race, while driven by innovation, also prompts urgent calls for caution and regulation to prevent unintended...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的快速发展，被形容为一场“赢者通吃”的竞赛，让人联想到《创世记》中巴别塔的故事。在创世记11章中，人类统一的野心试图通天，最终导致了神的干预和混乱。如今的人工智能竞赛，虽然由创新驱动，但也引发了对谨慎和监管的紧急呼吁，以防止意想不到的后果。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: Israeli minister calls for Oscar-winning film directors to be stripped of citizenship
title.zh: 以色列部长呼吁取消奥斯卡获奖电影导演的公民身份

summary.en: An Israeli minister has called for the citizenship of the directors of an Israeli-made documentary about Gaza to be revoked, accusing them of "treason against the state." The film, "NAZA," features interviews with Israeli military and intelligence whistleblowers detailing AI-powered targeting systems used in Gaza. The...
summary.zh: 一位以色列部长呼吁取消一部以色列制作的关于加沙的纪录片导演的公民身份，指责他们犯有“叛国罪”。这部名为《NAZA》的电影采访了以色列军方和情报部门的举报人，详细介绍了在加沙使用的由人工智能驱动的瞄准系统。该纪录片在威尼斯电影节上获得了特别评审团奖。

body.en:
An Israeli minister has called for the award-winning directors of an Israeli-made Gaza documentary to be stripped of citizenship, accusing them of "treason against the state".

In the film NAZA, Israeli directors Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor spoke to 24 different Israeli military or intelligence whistleblowers who outlined the AI-powered targeting systems used to bombard Gaza that have killed tens of thousands of civilians.

The 80-minute documentary won a special jury prize at this year's Venice Film Festival over the weekend.

Israel's culture minister Miki Zohar accused the directors of being willing to "harm their homeland in order to receive applause from antisemites around the world".

"I will act immediately to revoke the Israeli citizenship of these despicable creators for treason against the state," he wrote on X.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Abraham and Szor won an Oscar in 2025 for their film No Other Land about Israeli settler violence in the occupied West Bank .

The documentary received a record 25-minute standing ovation at its premiere on Thursday — the second year in succession that a film about Gaza has resonated in Venice after The Voice of Hind Rajab, a true-life account of the killing of a Palestinian girl during the war.

"The Israeli intelligence officers we spoke with talked to us about how this mass killing is systemic, not by accident, but by ‌design, actions of murder and policies that are based on the total dehumanisation of Palestinians," Abraham said on Saturday.

In NAZA, 24 Israeli military insiders, including intelligence officers and soldiers, gave insight into the war in Gaza and what they say is the systemic killing of Palestinian civilians.

The film was shot in secret on rooftops in Tel Aviv over three years, and digital alterations obscure the subjects' identities by altering their voices and appearances.

The film's title references an Israeli military acronym used as a shorthand for civilian casualties, including men, women and children.

The subjects in the film detail the surveillance systems and remote bombing involved in the Israeli military's operation, which they say uses artificial intelligence to identify potential Hamas targets and bomb their homes and apartments, often knowing that families are inside.

"We just told these officers and soldiers, please describe to us what you did," Abraham said in a news conference on Thursday. "Of course there were other questions that arose but the principal question was a question of detail — 'sketch it for us, we want to know how it worked'. And sometimes just asking the question, you get answers."

NAZA builds on reporting between...
body.zh: 以色列部长呼吁剥夺以色列制作的加沙纪录片的获奖导演的公民身份，指责他们“叛国”。 在电影《NAZA》中，以色列导演尤瓦尔·亚伯拉罕 (Yuval Abraham) 和雷切尔·索尔 (Rachel Szor) 与 24 名不同的以色列军方或情报举报人进行了交谈，他们概述了用于轰炸加沙的人工智能瞄准系统，该系统已造成数万名平民死亡。 这部 80 分钟的纪录片于上周末在今年的威尼斯电影节上获得了评审团特别奖。 以色列文化部长米基·佐哈尔指责导演们愿意“伤害自己的祖国，以获得世界各地反犹太主义者的掌声”。 他在 X 上写道：“我将立即采取行动，以叛国罪为由，撤销这些卑鄙创作者的以色列公民身份。” 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 亚伯拉罕和索尔凭借影片《无他之地》获得了 2025 年奥斯卡奖，该片讲述了以色列定居者在被占领的约旦河西岸的暴力行为。 这部纪录片在周四首映时获得了创纪录的 25 分钟起立鼓掌，这是继真实描述一名巴勒斯坦女孩在战争期间被杀的《印度之声》之后，有关加沙的电影连续第二年在威尼斯引起共鸣。 亚伯拉罕周六表示：“与我们交谈的以色列情报官员告诉我们，这种大规模杀戮是系统性的，不是偶然的，而是精心设计的、谋杀行为和基于对巴勒斯坦人完全非人化的政策。” 在 NAZA，24 名以色列军事内部人士，包括情报官员和士兵，深入了解了加沙战争以及他们所说的对巴勒斯坦平民的系统性杀害。 这部电影在特拉维夫的屋顶上秘密拍摄了三年，数字修改通过改变声音和外表来掩盖拍摄对象的身份。 影片的标题引用了以色列军方的缩写词，用作平民伤亡的速记，其中包括男性、女性和儿童。 影片中的主题详细介绍了以色列军方行动中涉及的监视系统和远程轰炸，他们说，这些行动使用人工智能来识别潜在的哈马斯目标，并轰炸他们的房屋和公寓，通常知道家人就在里面。 亚伯拉罕在周四的新闻发布会上说：“我们只是告诉这些官兵，请向我们描述一下你们做了什么。” “当然，还出现了其他问题，但主要问题是细节问题——‘为我们画出草图，我们想知道它是如何工作的’。有时只需提出问题，你就会得到答案。” NAZA 建立在...之间的报告之上

reflection.en: When state authorities demand silence or loyalty that conflicts with truth or conscience, the question of ultimate allegiance arises. The directors of "NAZA" faced intense pressure for presenting a critical perspective on military actions. The principle of obeying God over human rulers, even at personal cost, guides those who feel compelled to speak truth...
reflection.zh: 当国家当局要求沉默或要求与真相或良心相悖的忠诚时，就会出现最终效忠的问题。《NAZA》的导演们因提出对军事行动的批评性观点而面临巨大压力。即使要付出个人代价，也要服从上帝而非人类统治者的原则，指导着那些感到有义务向当权者说出真相的人。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Fears for two thirds of nation as displacement crisis grows in new front of Middle East war
title.zh: 也门冲突升级，人道危机加剧，或威胁全球航运路线

summary.en: Escalating conflict in Yemen has led to hundreds killed and tens of thousands displaced as Houthi forces advanced on key cities, seizing the Bab al-Mandab Strait, a vital global shipping route. The Houthis also claimed drone and missile attacks on Saudi Arabia.
summary.zh: 也门冲突升级，导致数百人死亡，数万人流离失所，胡塞武装部队向主要城市推进，并占领了重要的全球航运通道曼德海峡。胡塞武装还声称对沙特阿拉伯发动了无人机和导弹袭击。

body.en:
Hundreds have been killed and tens of thousands displaced as rebel Houthi forces in Yemen advanced on key cities in country over the weekend.

In advances following a week-long offensive that left hundreds dead, the Houthis seized the Yemeni side of the Bab al-Mandab Strait , one of the world's most important shipping arteries and the southern gateway to the Red Sea and the Suez Canal, threatening Saudi oil exports diverted from the Strait of Hormuz.

On Sunday, the Houthis — also known as Ansar Allah (supporters of God) — claimed to have used drones and missiles to target Saudi Arabia, including a military base just over the border with Yemen.

Houthi military spokesperson Yahya Saree didn't provide evidence or say when the attack occurred, according to the Associated Press.

Global charity Oxfam said escalations in Yemen pose a "dire threat" to an already struggling population after over a decade of civil war.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"The humanitarian impact is already severe," Yemen country director Ferran Puig said.

"Two thirds of the population in Yemen needs humanitarian assistance, and thousands are facing famine. Further military escalations will deepen hunger and displacement and disrupt the humanitarian assistance millions depend on to survive."

The Houthis are targeting Saudi oil infrastructure and shipping as part of a recently declared blockade, but they have said that other countries' shipping will not be targeted.

They now control the country's entire Red Sea coastline after capturing the key port city of Mocha in Taiz province from Yemeni government forces on Friday.

Government forces still control parts of Taiz province, including its capital city of the same name, but fighting in the area continues.

Military sources said that government forces had again attacked Houthi positions in the Taiz area.

More than 500 Yemeni troops have been killed during clashes with the Houthis between 9 August and 10 September, the government-aligned National Resistance Forces said in reports carried by local media in Yemen. The National Resistance Forces claimed that Houthi losses during the same period were far higher.

More than 950 violations against civilians have been documented across the western coast front lines following the Houthis’ entry into these cities, including more than 150 cases of killings, the Yemeni Network for Rights and Freedoms reported.

Residents have fled en masse towards Aden and the Lahj Governorate following the Houthis' takeover of the cities of Mocha and Khokha, as well as al-Wazi’iyah.

body.zh: 也门胡塞武装周末向该国主要城市推进，造成数百人死亡、数万人流离失所。 在长达一周的攻势导致数百人死亡后，胡塞武装占领了曼德海峡的也门一侧，这是世界上最重要的航运动脉之一，也是通往红海和苏伊士运河的南部门户，威胁到从霍尔木兹海峡转移的沙特石油出口。 周日，胡塞武装——也被称为安萨尔阿拉（上帝的支持者）——声称使用无人机和导弹瞄准沙特阿拉伯，其中包括与也门边境不远的一个军事基地。 据美联社报道，胡塞武装发言人叶海亚·萨里没有提供证据，也没有透露袭击发生的时间。 全球慈善机构乐施会表示，也门局势升级对十多年内战后本已陷入困境的民众构成“可怕威胁”。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 也门国家主任费兰·普伊格表示：“人道主义影响已经很严重。” “也门三分之二的人口需要人道主义援助，数千人面临饥荒。军事升级将加剧饥饿和流离失所，并扰乱数百万人赖以生存的人道主义援助。” 作为最近宣布的封锁的一部分，胡塞武装正在瞄准沙特的石油基础设施和航运，但他们表示，其他国家的航运不会成为目标。 周五从也门政府军手中夺取塔伊兹省主要港口城市摩卡后，他们现在控制了该国整个红海海岸线。 政府军仍然控制着塔伊兹省的部分地区，包括同名的首府城市，但该地区的战斗仍在继续。 军方消息人士称，政府军再次袭击了塔伊兹地区胡塞武装阵地。 也门当地媒体报道称，与政府结盟的国家抵抗军在8月9日至9月10日与胡塞武装的冲突中已造成500多名也门士兵死亡。国家抵抗军声称，同期胡塞武装的损失要高得多。 据也门权利与自由网络报道，胡塞武装进入这些城市后，西海岸前线记录了超过 950 起针对平民的侵犯行为，其中包括 150 多起杀戮案件。 胡塞武装占领摩卡市、科卡市以及瓦济耶市后，居民纷纷逃往亚丁和拉赫季省。 联合国难民事务高级专员办事处（难民署）表示...

reflection.en: The ongoing conflict in Yemen, marked by the Houthi seizure of the Bab al-Mandab Strait and advances on cities, highlights the devastating human cost of war. Amidst such persistent global conflicts, Psalm 46:9 offers a profound hope: 'He makes wars cease to the ends of the earth.' This verse points to a divine intervention that transcends human efforts,...
reflection.zh: 也门持续的冲突，以胡塞武装占领曼德海峡和向城市推进为标志，凸显了战争对人类造成的毁灭性代价。在这些持续不断的全球冲突中，《诗篇》46:9 提供了一个深刻的希望：“他使刀剑变为刀枪，把刀枪折断，直到地极，止息争战。”这节经文指向一种超越人类努力的神圣干预，承诺一个最终结束冲突的未来。

verse.textEn: He makes wars cease to the ends of the earth; he breaks the bow and shatters the spear.
verse.textZh: 他止息刀兵，直到地极；他折弓断枪。
