In the following Q&A, Bhambhwani explained how decentralized finance lending typically operates and how the connection to traditional financial systems might shape investors' perceptions of this growing market.

Decentralized finance, or DeFi, allows people to borrow and lend digital assets without going through a traditional financial institution such as a bank. Instead, transactions are handled through computer programs called "smart contracts" that operate on a blockchain, which is a shared ledger that many computers maintain at once, with no single owner.

A simple way to think about it is as a marketplace with pools of digital assets. Some users deposit assets into those pools and earn interest, while other users borrow from the pools and pay interest. Unlike a conventional bank loan, though, DeFi borrowing generally requires borrowers to put up cryptocurrency worth more than the amount they borrow as collateral. To borrow $80, we might have to lock up $100 of another asset. If our collateral falls close to the borrowed amount plus accrued interest, the software sells it automatically and repays the loan.

One attraction is accessibility. A DeFi program, known as a protocol, generally does not evaluate a borrower's credit score, income or employment history in the way a bank might. If a user has the necessary digital assets and meets the protocol's collateral requirements, the transaction can occur automatically. DeFi markets also operate around the clock and can be accessed from many parts of the world without opening a conventional bank account.

For depositors, the main attractions are yield and access. Deposits based on stablecoins—cryptocurrencies that are designed to maintain a steady price by being tied to a traditional asset, most often...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 随着过去十年来加密货币等数字资产的普及，在传统市场之外运作的去中心化金融体系的想法正在获得主流的吸引力。然而，宾夕法尼亚州立大学研究人员的一项新分析表明，传统市场和去中心化市场之间的联系比看上去更加紧密。 宾夕法尼亚州立大学 Smeal 商学院会计学助理临床教授 Siddharth Bhambhwani 将 2023 年 1 月至 2026 年 3 月期间提供点对点加密货币借贷的流行去中心化金融平台 Aave 的借贷利率和存款利率与美国国债收益率进行了比较。他发现，尽管两个市场之间没有直接联系，但国债收益率显着影响加密货币借贷市场的利率。 在接下来的问答中，Bhambhwani 解释了去中心化金融贷款通常如何运作，以及与传统金融体系的联系如何影响投资者对这个不断增长的市场的看法。 去中心化金融（DeFi）允许人们在不通过银行等传统金融机构的情况下借入和借出数字资产。相反，交易是通过在区块链上运行的称为“智能合约”的计算机程序来处理的，区块链是许多计算机同时维护的共享分类账，没有单一所有者。 一种简单的思考方式是将其视为一个拥有数字资产池的市场。一些用户将资产存入这些池中并赚取利息，而其他用户则从池中借款并支付利息。不过，与传统银行贷款不同的是，DeFi 借款通常要求借款人提供价值高于其借款金额的加密货币作为抵押品。要借入 80 美元，我们可能必须锁定另一项 100 美元的资产。如果我们的抵押品接近借款金额加上应计利息，软件会自动出售并偿还贷款。 吸引力之一是可达性。 DeFi 项目（也称为协议）通常不会像银行那样评估借款人的信用评分、收入或就业历史。如果用户拥有必要的数字资产并满足协议的抵押品要求，则交易可以自动发生。 DeFi 市场也全天候运行，无需开设传统银行账户即可从世界许多地方访问。 对于储户来说，主要的吸引力是收益和准入。基于稳定币的存款——加密货币旨在通过与传统资产挂钩来维持稳定的价格，最常见的是......

reflection.en: The allure of decentralized finance promises independence, yet this research suggests a deep entanglement with established systems. It raises questions about true autonomy and the integrity of financial dealings, reminding us that Yahweh detests dishonest practices, whether in old or new markets. True freedom in finance, as in life, may lie not in escaping...
reflection.zh: 去中心化金融的吸引力承诺了独立性，但这项研究表明它与现有系统有着深刻的纠葛。这引发了关于真正自主权和金融交易诚信的问题，提醒我们雅伟憎恶欺诈行为，无论是在旧市场还是新市场。金融中的真正自由，如同生活中的自由一样，可能不在于逃避现有结构，而在于在其中诚信行事。

verse.textEn: Yahweh detests dishonest scales, but accurate weights find favor with him.
verse.textZh: 诡诈的天平为雅伟所憎恶；公平的法码为他所喜悦。

title.en: Anger, hope and compassion do little to spur more climate donations
title.zh: 愤怒、希望和同情对气候捐款的刺激作用不大

summary.en: A new study suggests that emotional appeals like anger, hope, and compassion are less effective than previously thought in motivating people to donate to environmental causes. The research challenged participants to translate their feelings into financial contributions, finding a disconnect between emotional responses...
summary.zh: 一项新研究表明，愤怒、希望和同情等情感诉求在激励人们向环保事业捐款方面的效果不如以往认为的那样有效。该研究挑战参与者将他们的感受转化为经济贡献，发现情感反应与实际亲环境行为之间存在脱节。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Emotional mechanisms are frequently used to inspire good environmental behavior. But how effective are they at inspiring actual sustainable change? Perhaps not as much as previously believed, according to a new study that challenged participants to put their money where their mouths are.

The research examined how three climate-related emotions—anger, compassion and hope—can directly increase pro-environmental behavior. Participants were then invited to donate their participation fees to charity. The results surprised the researchers.

"We knew already that when people are angry, they are more motivated and have stronger intentions," explains Christian Klöckner, a professor at NTNU's Department of Psychology, who researches why people make environmentally friendly or unfriendly choices.

"When people have a bad conscience, they are more willing to accept climate policies. And we know that people need to hope that something can be done. Otherwise they don't do anything," he continues.

The power of these motivating factors has been tried and tested in previous studies. If people are angry, they are more likely to want to hold climate criminals to account. If they are compassionate, they are inclined to support victims. And if they have hope, they have intentions.

The new research surveyed more than 2,000 individuals in Norway and Poland. All participants were given 200 kroner or 20 złoty and exposed to a series of short stories designed to trigger different types of climate-related emotions.

"We used these stories to find out whether the participants intended to do something and then gave them the possibility to actually donate the money," says Klöckner.

"We also gave them another option, to work through a number of pretty boring sheets, where they had to find patterns. In return, we, the organizers, donated on their behalf. The more they did, the more we donated."

This "real impact task" makes the study stand out from other research in the field. The unexpected result was that the number of participants whose behavior changed based on the emotional content they read was negligible at best.

"Very few—hardly any—gave any more money because of the emotions they had been exposed to, compared with people who did not read the stories. We were surprised," admits Klöckner.

That is not to say the results should be considered exclusively in a negative light. The meaning of the research is much more nuanced than "people don't do what they say they're going to do."

Klöckner and his research team at NTNU's Department of Psychology have previously developed an instrument to...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 情感机制经常被用来激发良好的环境行为。但它们在激发实际的可持续变革方面有多有效呢？一项要求参与者将钱花在嘴边的新研究表明，也许没有以前认为的那么多。 该研究探讨了三种与气候相关的情绪——愤怒、同情和希望——如何直接增加亲环境行为。随后，参与者被邀请将其参与费用捐赠给慈善机构。结果令研究人员感到惊讶。 挪威科技大学心理学系教授克里斯蒂安·克洛克纳（Christian Klöckner）解释说：“我们已经知道，当人们生气时，他们会更有动力、有更强烈的意图。”他研究人们为什么会做出对环境友好或不友好​​的选择。 “当人们良心不安时，他们更愿意接受气候政策。我们知道人们需要希望能够有所作为。否则他们什么也不会做，”他继续说道。 这些激励因素的力量已经在之前的研究中得到了尝试和检验。如果人们感到愤怒，他们更有可能想要追究气候罪犯的责任。如果他们富有同情心，他们就会倾向于支持受害者。如果他们有希望，他们就有意图。 这项新研究调查了挪威和波兰的 2000 多人。所有参与者都获得了 200 克朗或 20 兹罗提，并听了一系列旨在引发不同类型的气候相关情绪的短篇故事。 “我们利用这些故事来了解参与者是否打算做某事，然后让他们有可能实际捐赠资金，”克洛克纳说。 “我们还给了他们另一种选择，让他们完成一些相当无聊的工作表，他们必须在其中找到模式。作为回报，我们组织者代表他们捐款。他们做得越多，我们捐赠的就越多。” 这项“真正影响任务”使该研究从该领域的其他研究中脱颖而出。意想不到的结果是，根据所阅读的情感内容而改变行为的参与者数量充其量可以忽略不计。 “与没有读过这些故事的人相比，很少——几乎没有人——因为所经历的情感而捐出更多的钱。我们很惊讶，”克洛克纳承认。 这并不是说应该完全从负面角度考虑结果。这项研究的意义比“人们不做他们说要做的事”要微妙得多。 Klöckner 和他在挪威科技大学心理学系的研究团队此前开发了一种工具......

reflection.en: This study reveals a common human tendency: feeling strongly about an issue doesn't automatically lead to action. James 2:15 asks, "If a brother or sister is without clothes and daily food, and one of you says to them, 'Go in peace; keep warm and well fed,' but does not provide what their body needs, what good is it?" The research on climate donations...
reflection.zh: 这项研究揭示了一种普遍的人类倾向：对某个问题感受强烈，并不一定会促使行动。雅各书 2:15 问道：“如果弟兄或姐妹赤身露体，缺少日用的饮食，你们中间有人对他们说：‘平平安安地去吧，愿你们既保暖又吃饱’，却不给他们身体所需要的，这有什么益处呢？”关于气候捐款的研究呼应了这一点，表明即使对环境有强烈的情感，如果没有实际的支持行动也是不够的。

verse.textEn: Suppose a brother or a sister is without clothes and daily food. If one of you says to them, 'Go in peace; keep warm and well fed,' but does nothing about their physical needs, what good is it?
verse.textZh: 若是弟兄或是姊妹，赤身露体，又缺了日用的饮食，你们中间有人对他们说：「平平安安地去吧，愿你们穿得暖、吃得饱」，却不给他们身体所需用的，这有什么益处呢？

title.en: Singles in America survey reveals how relationships, marriage, money and family are changing
title.zh: 美国单身人士调查揭示了人际关系、婚姻、金钱和家庭的变化

summary.en: The Kinsey Institute has released new findings from its annual 'Singles in America' survey, now in its 15th year. This comprehensive study, which has surveyed over 80,000 individuals nationwide, provides extensive data on evolving relationship patterns, demographics, and social trends.
summary.zh: 金赛研究所发布了其年度“美国单身人士”调查的最新研究结果，该调查现已进入第15个年头。这项全面的研究已在美国范围内调查了超过80,000名个人，为理解不断变化的恋爱模式、人口统计和 به اجتماعی趋势提供了丰富的数据。

body.en: The Kinsey Institute released new data from its annual Singles in America survey, the nation's most comprehensive and longest-running annual study of single adults. Now in its 15th edition, Singles in America has surveyed more than 80,000 people across the United States, creating one of the richest data sets available for understanding shifting relationship patterns, population demographics and social trends.
body.zh: 金赛研究所发布了年度美国单身人士调查的新数据，这是美国最全面、持续时间最长的单身成年人年度研究。 《美国单身人士》现已推出第 15 期，调查了全美 80,000 多人，创建了最丰富的数据集之一，可用于了解不断变化的关系模式、人口统计和社会趋势。

reflection.en: As human knowledge expands, as seen in the extensive data gathered by the 'Singles in America' survey, we are presented with ever more complex social landscapes. The accumulation of information allows us to observe and analyze trends, yet true wisdom lies in discerning how these shifts impact human flourishing and our relationships with one another.
reflection.zh: 随着人类知识的增长，正如“美国单身人士”调查所收集的大量数据所示，我们面临着日益复杂的社会格局。信息的积累使我们能够观察和分析趋势，但真正的智慧在于辨别这些变化如何影响人类的繁荣以及我们彼此之间的关系。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Hidden receptor interactions may explain past failures of brain disorder drugs
title.zh: 隐藏的受体相互作用可能解释了过去脑部疾病药物的失败

summary.en: Metabotropic glutamate receptors, which are important but difficult drug targets, interact in surprisingly varied ways with their principal regulatory proteins, according to two new studies led by Weill Cornell Medicine investigators. The findings represent a major step forward in understanding these receptors and how...
summary.zh: 根据韦尔康奈尔医学院研究人员领导的两项新研究，作为重要但难以靶向的药物靶点，代谢型谷氨酸受体与其主要的调节蛋白以令人惊讶的多样方式相互作用。这些发现代表了在理解这些受体以及如何有效靶向它们以治疗癫痫、抑郁和焦虑症等疾病方面迈出的重要一步。

body.en: Metabotropic glutamate receptors, which are important but difficult drug targets, interact in surprisingly varied ways with their principal regulatory proteins, according to two new studies led by Weill Cornell Medicine investigators. The findings represent a major step forward in understanding these receptors and how they can be targeted effectively to potentially treat conditions such as epilepsy, depression and anxiety disorders.
body.zh: 威尔康奈尔医学研究人员领导的两项新研究表明，代谢型谷氨酸受体是重要但困难的药物靶点，与其主要调节蛋白以令人惊讶的不同方式相互作用。这些发现代表着在理解这些受体以及如何有效地靶向它们来潜在治疗癫痫、抑郁症和焦虑症等疾病方面向前迈出了重要一步。

reflection.en: The pursuit of knowledge, even into the complex and hidden mechanisms of the human body, reflects a deep human impulse to understand the world around us. These Weill Cornell Medicine investigators, through diligent study, have uncovered new layers of interaction within the brain's receptor systems. This echoes the ancient wisdom that observing the intricate...
reflection.zh: 追求知识，即使是深入研究人体复杂而隐秘的机制，也反映了人类理解周围世界的深刻冲动。这些韦尔康奈尔医学院的研究人员通过勤奋的研究，揭示了大脑受体系统中相互作用的新层面。这呼应了古老的智慧：观察创造的复杂运作可以带来深刻的理解。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: US scraps limits on emissions from coal and gas power plants
title.zh: 美国取消对燃煤和燃气发电厂排放的限制

summary.en: The US Environmental Protection Agency has announced the scrapping of regulations designed to limit pollution from coal and gas power plants. The agency stated this move would save billions of dollars and reduce energy prices, while environmental groups warned of significant costs to public health and the planet,...
summary.zh: 美国环保署宣布取消旨在限制燃煤和燃气发电厂污染的法规。该机构表示，此举将节省数十亿美元并降低能源价格，而环保组织则警告将对公众健康和地球造成巨大代价，并预计将面临法律挑战。

body.en:
Rules aimed at limiting pollution from coal and gas power plants are being scrapped, the head of the US Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) has announced.

The agency also said it would take steps to prevent future administrations from regulating power plant emissions.

The EPA said that getting rid of the majority of the climate rules from President Joe Biden's era would save $310bn (£223bn) and reduce energy prices.

But environmental groups warned it would come at a huge cost to Americans' health and the planet. The EPA's move is expected to face immediate legal challenges.

"The reality is that America produces energy better and cleaner than anywhere else in the world, and our power plants should not be unfairly targeted," the head of the EPA, Lee Zeldin, said on Monday.

Fossil fuels, which include coal and natural gas, are by far the largest driver of global climate change, according to the United Nations.

The EPA said in a statement that it found the Biden-era rules on power plant emissions had "exceeded the agency's authority".

The agency said the regulations required "control technologies that are not adequately demonstrated, effectively forcing plants to retire rather than setting standards they could actually meet".

The EPA is also seeking to get rid of all other greenhouse gas rules for the power sector.

The changes, which will undergo public scrutiny, were proposed last year by Zeldin.

He said the new rules would "ensure affordable and reliable energy supplies and drive down the costs of transportation, heating, utilities, farming, and manufacturing while boosting our national security".

The Biden-era regulations called for a major reduction in carbon emissions from power plants, as well as vehicles and industrial facilities. It was estimated that the measures would stop 4,500 premature deaths annually.

But the EPA said on Monday: "Any potential public health harms are too uncertain, conjectural, remote, and convoluted to tie specifically to the US power sector."

Zeldin told reporters that safeguards against "hazardous air pollutants" would remain in place "to safeguard human health".

Nathaniel Keohane, president of the Center for Climate and Energy Solutions – an independent environmental organisation – described the move as "a giant step backward".

"In repealing carbon pollution standards for power plants, EPA has ignored sound science and economics and abdicated its responsibility to protect public health and welfare," Keohane added.

The US is currently the second-biggest emitter of planet-warming greenhouse gases, such as carbon dioxide, behind China.

And the power sector makes up about a quarter of US emissions, at roughly 1.5 billion tonnes of carbon dioxide-equivalent each year, according to the latest available...
body.zh: 美国环境保护署（EPA）负责人宣布，旨在限制燃煤和天然气发电厂污染的规定将被废除。 该机构还表示，将采取措施阻止未来政府监管发电厂排放。 美国环保局表示，废除乔·拜登总统时代的大部分气候规则将节省 3100 亿美元（2230 亿英镑）并降低能源价格。 但环保组织警告称，这将使美国人的健康和地球付出巨大代价。环保局的举动预计将立即面临法律挑战。 美国环保局局长李·泽尔丁周一表示：“现实情况是，美国生产的能源比世界上其他任何地方都更好、更清洁，我们的发电厂不应该成为不公平的目标。” 据联合国称，包括煤炭和天然气在内的化石燃料是迄今为止全球气候变化的最大驱动因素。 美国环保署在一份声明中表示，它发现拜登时代关于发电厂排放的规定“超出了该机构的权限”。 该机构表示，这些法规要求“控制未充分论证的技术，实际上迫使工厂退役，而不是制定它们实际可以达到的标准”。 美国环保署还寻求废除电力行业的所有其他温室气体规则。 这些变化是泽尔丁去年提出的，将接受公众监督。 他表示，新规则将“确保负担得起且可靠的能源供应，降低运输、供暖、公用事业、农业和制造业的成本，同时增强我们的国家安全”。 拜登时代的法规要求大幅减少发电厂、车辆和工业设施的碳排放。据估计，这些措施每年将阻止 4,500 人过早死亡。 但美国环保局周一表示：“任何潜在的公共健康危害都过于不确定、推测、遥远且复杂，无法与美国电力部门具体联系起来。” 泽尔丁告诉记者，针对“有害空气污染物”的防范措施将继续存在，“以保障人类健康”。 独立环境组织气候与能源解决方案中心主席纳撒尼尔·基欧汉 (Nathaniel Keohane) 称此举是“巨大的倒退”。 基欧汉补充说：“在废除发电厂碳污染标准的过程中，美国环保局忽视了合理的科学和经济学，并放弃了保护公众健康和福利的责任。” 美国目前是二氧化碳等全球变暖温室气体的第二大排放国，仅次于中国。 根据最新的可用数据，电力行业约占美国排放量的四分之一，每年排放约 15 亿吨二氧化碳当量……

reflection.en: The decision to dismantle environmental protections in favor of economic savings raises profound questions about stewardship and justice. Micah 6:8 calls us to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with our God. This directive challenges leaders and citizens alike to consider the long-term well-being of creation and its inhabitants, not just immediate...
reflection.zh: 为追求经济效益而拆除环境保护措施的决定，引发了关于管理和公义的深刻问题。弥迦书6章8节呼吁我们行公义，好怜悯，并以谦卑的心与我们的雅伟同行。这一指示要求领导者和公民都必须考虑长远的福祉，不仅是眼前的经济利益，也包括对受造界及其居民的责任。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Giant jellyfish with '40ft tentacles' captured on camera off coast
title.zh: 巨型水母“触手长达40英尺”被拍下

summary.en: Iestyn Morgan has set out to make Welsh aquatic life "more accessible" for people to see.
summary.zh: Iestyn Morgan 致力于让威尔士的水生生物“更容易被人们看到”。

body.en:
A free diver has said he "couldn't believe his luck" after spotting a giant jellyfish off the Welsh coastline.

Iestyn Morgan, from Pembrokeshire, said the lion's mane was the "length of a bus" with a size of about 10 to 15 metres (32ft 8in to 49ft 2in).

The 21-year-old conservationist, who records footage for social media to raise awareness about the "threats our seas are facing" , said it was the first lion's mane he had seen in Wales.

More commonly found in the colder waters off Scotland, a marine biologist said although the lion's main sting was "nasty", it was not dangerous.

Morgan said he was swimming near Trefin Beach in Pembrokeshire when he spotted the tentacles in the water.

He initially thought it was a compass jellyfish , which are native to UK waters, before realising it was too big.

"It must have been the length of a bus or small train. I couldn't believe how big it was."

The Wildlife Trusts , external said the lion's mane jellyfish gets its name from its long tentacles, and have "all the beauty and bite of a lion".

They can grow up to 3m (9ft 8in) in length, but the tentacles - which are used to catch their prey - can exceed 30 to 36.5 metres (98ft 4in to 119ft 8in) making it one of the longest animals on Earth.

Marine biologist Dr Cathy Lucas, from the University of Southampton, said Morgan's video showed the animal's incredible length.

"The tentacles are so long and so fine you might not even see them," she said, recalling how during field work in Scotland divers would get bits of tentacles on them when there were no jellyfish around.

"They still sting after they break off," she said, adding that while the sting was "nasty" and "the worst in the UK", it was not dangerous.

"The advice is not to touch them and if you get a bit of tentacle on your skin flick it off with a stick and wash in warm water to neutralise," she said.

Lucas said lion's manes "occasionally" reach the Welsh coast later in the summer or autumn, according to jellyfish sightings recorded by the public, but their main habitat in the UK was Scotland.

Morgan feels we should be "grateful" they were in Wales, adding they were not "big scary monsters" as some people may think.

"Your biggest problem is if you swim into them. You don't want to get stung by a lion's mane."

Morgan said he was seeing "more and more" jellyfish coming into Welsh waters as he was filming.

He said it was part of a theme in which he was noticing warm water species "becoming more abundant".

"I don't have enough summers to compare it to, but I put down a camera a few weeks ago and saw a Triggerfish, which is native to the Mediterranean," he added.

Morgan said creating his content has been "very rewarding" as he wanted to make aquatic environments "more accessible" to people.

But he...
body.zh: 一名自由潜水员在威尔士海岸线发现巨型水母后表示，他“简直不敢相信自己的运气”。 来自彭布罗克郡的 Iestyn Morgan 表示，狮子的鬃毛有“一辆公共汽车的长度”，大小约为 10 至 15 米（32 英尺 8 英寸至 49 英尺 2 英寸）。 这位 21 岁的自然资源保护主义者为社交媒体录制视频，以提高人们对“我们的海洋面临的威胁”的认识，他说这是他在威尔士看到的第一只狮子鬃毛。 一位海洋生物学家表示，这种狮子在苏格兰附近较冷的水域中更为常见，尽管狮子的主要螫刺很“恶心”，但并不危险。 摩根说，他在彭布罗克郡特雷芬海滩附近游泳时，发现了水中的触手。 他最初以为这是一种罗盘水母，原产于英国水域，后来意识到它太大了。 “它一定有公共汽车或小火车的长度。我简直不敢相信它有多大。” 野生动物信托基金会对外表示，狮鬃水母因其长长的触手而得名，并且具有“狮子的所有美丽和咬合力”。 它们的长度可达 3 m（9 英尺 8 英寸），但用于捕捉猎物的触手可超过 30 至 36.5 米（98 英尺 4 英寸至 119 英尺 8 英寸），使其成为地球上最长的动物之一。 南安普顿大学的海洋生物学家凯茜·卢卡斯博士说，摩根的视频显示了这种动物令人难以置信的长度。 “触手又长又细，你可能根本看不到它们，”她说，并回忆起在苏格兰进行野外工作时，当周围没有水母时，潜水员会在触手上沾上一些触手。 她说：“它们折断后仍然会蜇人。”她补充说，虽然蜇人的感觉“很恶心”，而且是“英国最严重的”，但并不危险。 她说：“建议不要触摸它们，如果皮肤上有一点触手，请用棍子将其弹开，然后用温水清洗以中和。” 卢卡斯表示，根据公众记录的水母目击事件，狮鬃“偶尔”会在夏季或秋季晚些时候到达威尔士海岸，但它们在英国的主要栖息地是苏格兰。 摩根认为我们应该“感激”他们在威尔士，并补充说他们并不像某些人想象的那样是“可怕的大怪物”。 “你最大的问题是，如果你游进它们里。你不想被狮子的鬃毛蜇到。” 摩根表示，在拍摄过程中，他看到“越来越多”的水母进入威尔士水域。 他说，这是他注意到暖水物种“变得更加丰富”的主题的一部分。 “我没有足够的夏天来比较，但几周前我放下相机，看到了一种原产于地中海的炮弹鱼，”他补充道。 摩根表示，创作内容“非常有意义”，因为他想让人们“更容易接触到”水生环境。 但他...

reflection.en: A free diver's encounter with a massive lion's mane jellyfish off the Welsh coast is a reminder of the wonders hidden in our oceans. Iestyn Morgan's work to share these sights aims to foster appreciation and awareness of marine life, turning a potentially frightening encounter into an opportunity for education and conservation. This effort to bring the...
reflection.zh: 一位自由潜水员在威尔士海岸附近邂逅巨型狮鬃水母，这提醒我们海洋中隐藏着多少奇迹。Iestyn Morgan 致力于分享这些景象，旨在培养人们对海洋生物的欣赏和认识，将一次可能令人恐惧的相遇转化为教育和保护的机会。这种努力将海洋之美带给人们，尽管海洋面临挑战，却体现了一种积极参与的精神。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Scientists discover dispersal mechanism and new gene family in harmful E. coli strains
title.zh: 科学家发现有害大肠杆菌菌株的传播机制和新基因家族

summary.en: Researchers from Tokyo Metropolitan University have identified how certain dangerous bacteria spread. They studied chain-like adherence pattern (CLAP) varieties of Shiga toxin-producing E. coli (STEC), finding that single bacteria attach to a surface and elongate before dividing, producing chains without ever...
summary.zh: 东京都市大学的研究人员已经确定了某些危险细菌的传播方式。他们研究了产生志贺毒素的大肠杆菌（STEC）的链状粘附模式（CLAP）变种，发现单个细菌附着在表面并伸长，然后分裂，形成永不分离的链条。在流动条件下，被撕断的链端可以附着在其他地方，从而分散菌株。他们发现了一个介导CLAP形成的新基因家族，阐明了感染机制的新方面。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Researchers from Tokyo Metropolitan University have identified how certain dangerous bacteria spread. They studied chain-like adherence pattern (CLAP) varieties of Shiga toxin-producing E. coli (STEC), finding that single bacteria attach to a surface and elongate before dividing, producing chains without ever separating.

Under flow, chain ends that are torn off can attach elsewhere, dispersing the strain. They identified a new gene family mediating CLAP formation, illuminating new aspects of infection mechanisms and potential treatments.

Shiga toxin-producing Escherichia coli (STEC) are harmful bacteria responsible for serious food poisoning outbreaks, with a particular risk of severe disease and death in young children and older adults. Most strains feature the locus of enterocyte effacement (LEE) within their genome, giving bacteria the ability to create lesions in the intestinal tract that help them attach and grow.

While this is a major pathway by which STEC strains infect a host, LEE-negative strains, which have also been discovered, can be just as deadly, as demonstrated in a 2011 outbreak in Germany involving the STEC strain O104:H4. Since they lack the molecular machinery conferred by LEE, scientists have yet to fully understand how these strains cause infection and spread.

To tackle this challenge, a team at Tokyo Metropolitan University led by doctoral candidate Yuto Kotaka studied chain-like adherence pattern (CLAP) varieties of LEE-negative STEC strains. In O91, a frequently isolated LEE-negative strain in Japan, the European Union and the United Kingdom, bacteria were found to form threads or chains, but the way they are formed and dispersed was not understood.

In recent work, the team observed how these chains formed under a microscope. Instead of aggregating, they found that single bacteria could attach to a surface, elongate and then divide without individual bacteria ever separating. Crucially, they found that environmental factors that might prevent bacteria from developing a foothold, such as strong flow, could be used by the bacteria to disperse.

For chains under flow, the team saw that the ends of a thread were torn off while leaving part of the original chain intact. This separated segment was carried downstream, where it could attach to a surface again and continue to grow. Thus, flow can form part of the strain's surface-colonization strategy over wider areas.

To study the genetic factors essential for CLAP phenotypes, the team undertook a wide-ranging study of CLAP strains isolated in Japan. In analyzing the genes encoding the EibG...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 东京都立大学的研究人员已经确定了某些危险细菌的传播方式。他们研究了产志贺毒素大肠杆菌（STEC）的链状粘附模式（CLAP）品种，发现单个细菌附着在表面上并在分裂前伸长，产生链而不会分离。 在流动情况下，撕下的链条末端可以附着在其他地方，从而分散压力。他们发现了介导 CLAP 形成的新基因家族，阐明了感染机制和潜在治疗的新方面。 产生志贺毒素的大肠杆菌 (STEC) 是有害细菌，会导致严重的食物中毒爆发，特别是幼儿和老年人患严重疾病和死亡的风险。大多数菌株的基因组中都具有肠细胞消失位点（LEE），使细菌能够在肠道中产生损伤，帮助它们附着和生长。 虽然这是 STEC 菌株感染宿主的主要途径，但已发现的 LEE 阴性菌株也可能同样致命，正如 2011 年德国爆发的 STEC 菌株 O104:H4 所证明的那样。由于它们缺乏 LEE 赋予的分子机制，科学家们尚未完全了解这些菌株如何引起感染和传播。 为了应对这一挑战，东京都立大学博士生 Yuto Kotaka 领导的一个团队研究了 LEE 阴性 STEC 菌株的链状粘附模式 (CLAP) 品种。 O91 是日本、欧盟和英国经常分离到的 LEE 阴性菌株，在 O91 中，细菌被发现形成线或链，但它们形成和分散的方式尚不清楚。 在最近的工作中，研究小组观察了这些链是如何在显微镜下形成的。他们发现单个细菌不会聚集，而是可以附着在表面上，拉长，然后分裂，而单个细菌永远不会分离。至关重要的是，他们发现可能阻止细菌立足的环境因素（例如强水流）可以被细菌利用来分散。 对于流动下的链条，研究小组发现线的末端被撕裂，而原始链条的一部分完好无损。这个分离的片段被带到下游，在那里它可以再次附着到表面并继续生长。因此，流动可以构成菌株在更广泛区域的表面定殖策略的一部分。 为了研究 CLAP 表型所必需的遗传因素，研究小组对在日本分离的 CLAP 菌株进行了广泛的研究。在分析编码 EibG 的基因时...

reflection.en: The intricate mechanisms by which bacteria like E. coli spread and adapt reveal the complexity of the created world. As scientists uncover these details, they are, in essence, observing the wisdom inherent in Yahweh's creation. This pursuit of knowledge, even concerning harmful organisms, reflects a divinely-given capacity to understand the world around us.
reflection.zh: 大肠杆菌等细菌传播和适应的复杂机制揭示了受造世界的精妙之处。科学家们在揭示这些细节时，实际上是在观察雅伟创造物中固有的智慧。这种对知识的追求，即使是关于有害生物的知识，也反映了神赐予我们理解周围世界的能力。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: From atomic vibrations to laboratory mechanics: Bridging 20 orders of magnitude in time
title.zh: 从原子振动到实验室力学：跨越20个数量级的时间

summary.en: Scientists are working to bridge the gap between the ultrafast motion of atoms and the slow deformations observed in laboratory settings to predict how materials like polymers behave mechanically across vastly different timescales. This is a complex challenge because a material's stiffness depends heavily on the speed...
summary.zh: 科学家们正致力于弥合原子超快运动与实验室观测到的缓慢变形之间的差距，以预测聚合物等材料在截然不同的时间尺度上的力学行为。这是一个复杂的挑战，因为材料的刚度在很大程度上取决于变形的速度。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

How can we predict the way a real material, such as a polymer, responds mechanically over timescales ranging from the ultrafast motion of atoms to the slow deformations measured in a laboratory? This is a deceptively difficult problem.

A glassy polymer such as poly(methyl methacrylate), or PMMA, does not have a single mechanical stiffness. Its response depends strongly on how fast we deform it. At extremely high frequencies, atoms and molecular bonds respond almost instantaneously. At lower frequencies, molecules have progressively more time to rearrange, and the material becomes softer. Eventually, slow molecular relaxation processes begin to dominate.

The difficulty is that no single experimental or computational technique can normally follow all of these regimes.

Molecular dynamics simulations can resolve only the fastest atomic motions, but the shortness of the time step involved in atomic motions makes it extremely difficult to reach the timescales of ordinary mechanical experiments. Dynamic mechanical analysis, at the opposite end, probes much slower deformation. Other techniques—including Brillouin light scattering, ultrasonic measurements and high-strain-rate tests—fill in portions of the enormous gap between them.

As a result, we normally obtain separate snapshots of the same material taken at very different "speeds."

In our recent work, published in The Journal of Chemical Physics , my colleagues and I asked whether all of these apparently disconnected regimes could instead be predicted starting from the atomic structure of the polymer itself.

We studied PMMA using an atomistic model containing 9,920 atoms. Rather than trying to simulate every possible deformation directly over increasingly long periods of time—which would rapidly become computationally impossible—we extracted information about the material's atomic vibrations and about how those vibrations couple to an imposed deformation.

The theoretical framework we use is based on non-affine lattice dynamics (NALD), a framework that I contributed to develop along with my longtime collaborator Dr. Tim Sirk at the U.S. Army Research Laboratory.

The word "non-affine" is important. If a perfectly ordered solid is deformed, one might imagine every atom simply following the imposed macroscopic deformation. But amorphous materials such as polymer glasses are structurally disordered. Their atoms do not all follow the deformation uniformly. Instead, many atoms make additional local rearrangements.

Our theory calculates this softening by connecting the vibrational modes of the atomic structure with the...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 我们如何预测真实材料（例如聚合物）在从原子的超快运动到实验室测量的缓慢变形的时间尺度上的机械响应方式？这是一个看似困难的问题。 诸如聚甲基丙烯酸甲酯或 PMMA 之类的玻璃状聚合物不具有单一的机械刚度。它的反应很大程度上取决于我们变形它的速度。在极高的频率下，原子和分子键几乎立即响应。在较低的频率下，分子有更多的时间重新排列，并且材料变得更软。最终，缓慢的分子弛豫过程开始占主导地位。 困难在于没有任何一种实验或计算技术能够正常遵循所有这些机制。 分子动力学模拟只能解决最快的原子运动，但原子运动所涉及的时间步长很短，因此很难达到普通力学实验的时间尺度。另一方面，动态力学分析探测到的变形要慢得多。其他技术——包括布里渊光散射、超声波测量和高应变率测试——填补了它们之间的部分巨大差距。 因此，我们通常会获得以非常不同的“速度”拍摄的相同材料的单独快照。 在我们最近发表在《化学物理杂志》上的工作中，我和我的同事询问是否可以从聚合物本身的原子结构开始预测所有这些明显不相关的状态。 我们使用包含 9,920 个原子的原子模型研究 PMMA。我们没有尝试在越来越长的时间内直接模拟每种可能的变形（这在计算上很快就会变得不可能），而是提取有关材料原子振动以及这些振动如何与施加的变形耦合的信息。 我们使用的理论框架基于非仿射晶格动力学 (NALD)，这是我与美国陆军研究实验室的长期合作者 Tim Sirk 博士共同开发的框架。 “非仿射”这个词很重要。如果完美有序的固体发生变形，人们可能会想象每个原子都简单地遵循所施加的宏观变形。但聚合物玻璃等无定形材料在结构上是无序的。它们的原子并不都均匀地遵循变形。相反，许多原子会进行额外的局部重排。 我们的理论通过将原子结构的振动模式与......联系起来来计算这种软化。

reflection.en: The Psalmist asks, 'Who among these is wise?' and points to the natural world as a source of understanding. This research delves into the fundamental behaviors of matter, from the fleeting atomic dance to macroscopic responses. It echoes the ancient wisdom that observing creation reveals its intricate design and underlying principles.
reflection.zh: 诗人曾问：“其中谁不晓得雅伟的手所做的呢？”并指出自然界是理解的源泉。这项研究深入探讨了物质的基本行为，从短暂的原子之舞到宏观的响应。它呼应了古老的智慧：观察受造界可以揭示其精妙的设计和基本原理。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: UK could 'unlock' 100 more oil and gas projects, say North Sea bosses
title.zh: 英国北海石油和天然气行业表示，若获政府支持，可再开发100个项目

summary.en: An industry report by Offshore Energies UK (OEUK) claims that the UK could meet half of its oil and gas needs domestically without imports if the government provides more support. The report suggests that changes to windfall taxes and approval of new fields could unlock 111 projects, attracting £50 billion in...
summary.zh: 英国离岸能源公司（OEUK）的一份行业报告声称，如果政府提供更多支持，英国可以 domestic 地满足一半的石油和天然气需求，而无需进口。报告指出，改革暴利税和批准新油气田可以启动111个项目，吸引500亿英镑的投资。然而，环保组织批评该报告不切实际。

body.en:
The UK could supply half of its oil and gas needs without imports if the government showed more support for the sector, an industry report claims.

Offshore Energies UK (OEUK) said changes to the windfall tax on energy firms and approval of the controversial Rosebank and Jackdaw fields could unlock 111 projects, attracting investment worth £50bn.

North Sea output has been falling and projections suggest that the UK's domestic supplies will meet only about a third of demand until 2050.

Environmental group Uplift branded the report a "fantasy" and said that the Prime Minister should not listen to "self-interested demands" of oil companies.

The OEUK report sets out the industry's case for supporting domestic production of oil and gas and displacing imports, which have increased.

It calls for the current Energy Profits Levy (EPL), a windfall tax on oil and gas producers which is due to be replaced in 2030, to be scrapped by next January.

The replacement Oil and Gas Revenue Levy would be triggered only when prices spike.

The sector has long said the EPL has significantly stifled investment because it remains in place even when wholesale oil and gas prices fall.

Last year, for the first time since the North Sea began producing oil and gas, not a single exploration well was drilled.

OEUK said the oil and gas industry supported 180,000 jobs in 2024 across the UK.

The report said that "fiscal reform and a pragmatic approach to licensing could unlock investment and improve long-term energy security".

It said that boosting domestic energy production was vital for "protecting households, businesses and the wider economy from global shocks".

Policy Director Enrique Cornejo added: "Britain is at a critical juncture. Our industry is ready to invest and deliver more homegrown oil and gas, but the window for action is narrowing.

"Without urgent policy decisions, the UK risks increasing its dependence on imports, losing high-value jobs."

The second demand from the industry is a signal of long term support for domestic oil and gas production.

In essence, that means supporting the controversial Rosebank and Jackdaw developments which are currently being considered for permitting by the industry regulator.

Both projects had already been given the go-ahead under the previous Conservative government but were successfully challenged in the Scottish courts on environmental grounds.

It has meant all other potential projects have essentially been put on hold under the decisions are taken.

One of the environmental groups which brought the legal challenges, Uplift, has described OEUK's calls for support as a "fantasy" and says the North Sea is an "ultra-mature" basin with very little reserves left.

It said that instead of listening to the "self-interested...
body.zh: 一份行业报告称，如果政府对石油和天然气行业提供更多支持，英国可以在不进口的情况下满足其一半的石油和天然气需求。 英国离岸能源公司（OEUK）表示，对能源公司暴利税的改变以及有争议的罗斯班克和寒鸦油田的批准可能会释放111个项目，吸引价值500亿英镑的投资。 北海产量一直在下降，预计到 2050 年，英国国内供应只能满足需求的约三分之一。 环保组织Uplift将这份报告称为“幻想”，并表示总理不应听取石油公司的“自利要求”。 OEUK 报告阐述了该行业支持国内石油和天然气生产并取代进口量增加的理由。 它呼吁在明年 1 月之前废除现行的能源利润税 (EPL)，这是一项针对石油和天然气生产商的暴利税，将于 2030 年取代。 仅当价格飙升时才会触发替代石油和天然气收入税。 该行业长期以来一直表示，EPL 严重抑制了投资，因为即使石油和天然气批发价格下跌，它仍然存在。 去年，自北海开始生产石油和天然气以来，第一次没有钻探一口勘探井。 OEUK表示，到2024年，石油和天然气行业将为英国提供18万个就业岗位。 报告称，“财政改革和务实的许可方式可以释放投资并改善长期能源安全”。 报告称，提高国内能源生产对于“保护家庭、企业和更广泛的经济免受全球冲击”至关重要。 政策总监恩里克·科尔内霍补充道：“英国正处于关键时刻。我们的行业已准备好投资和提供更多本土石油和天然气，但采取行动的窗口正在缩小。 “如果不做出紧急政策决定，英国将面临增加对进口依赖、失去高价值就业机会的风险。” 行业的第二个需求是长期支持国内油气生产的信号。 从本质上讲，这意味着支持有争议的 Rosebank 和 Jackdaw 开发项目，行业监管机构目前正在考虑批准这些开发项目。 这两个项目均已在前任保守党政府的领导下获得批准，但在苏格兰法院以环境为由成功受到质疑。 这意味着所有其他潜在项目基本上都在做出决定后被搁置。 提出法律挑战的环保组织之一 Uplift 将 OEUK 的支持呼吁描述为“幻想”，并表示北海是一个“超成熟”盆地，所剩储量所剩无几。 它说，与其听“自私的……”

reflection.en: The push to unlock more oil and gas projects in the North Sea, as detailed in the OEUK report, highlights the complex interplay between economic development and environmental concerns. While industry leaders see potential for investment and energy security, critics label such proposals as 'fantasy.' This tension calls for careful consideration of long-term...
reflection.zh: 英国北海石油和天然气行业报告中提出的开发更多石油和天然气项目的呼吁，凸显了经济发展与环境关切之间的复杂互动。尽管行业领导者看到了投资和能源安全的潜力，但批评者却称这些提议是“幻想”。这种紧张关系要求我们仔细权衡长远后果以及对资源的合乎道德的管理。

verse.textEn: Yahweh detests dishonest scales, but accurate weights find favor with him.
verse.textZh: 诡诈的天平为雅伟所憎恶；公平的法码为他所喜悦。

title.en: Flash flooding interrupts half-marathon, submerges cars
title.zh: 洪水突袭半程马拉松，汽车被淹

summary.en: Parts of New York, New Jersey and Connecticut were hit by flash flooding, leading to water rescues, stranded motorists and half-marathon runners battling the floodwaters. Connecticut officials said parts of the state saw up to seven inches of rain in a very short period of time, according to the BBC's partner, CBS...
summary.zh: 纽约州、新泽西州和康涅狄格州的部分地区遭遇了山洪暴发，导致了水上救援、车辆滞留以及半程马拉松选手在洪水中艰难前行。据英国广播公司（BBC）的合作伙伴哥伦比亚广播公司新闻（CBS News）报道，康涅狄格州官员称该州部分地区在极短时间内降雨量高达七英寸。

body.en: Parts of New York, New Jersey and Connecticut were hit by flash flooding leading to water rescues, stranded motorists and half-marathon runners struggling through waist-deep flood waters. Connecticut officials said parts of the state saw up to seven inches of rain in a very short period of time, according to the BBC's partner, CBS News.
body.zh: 纽约、新泽西和康涅狄格州部分地区遭受山洪袭击，导致水上救援、被困的驾车者和半程马拉松运动员在齐腰深的洪水中挣扎。据 BBC 合作伙伴哥伦比亚广播公司新闻报道，康涅狄格州官员表示，该州部分地区在很短的时间内降雨量高达 7 英寸。

reflection.en: The sudden deluge in New York, New Jersey, and Connecticut brought unexpected chaos, turning a race into a struggle for safety. In moments of disruption, the call to pursue peace and order, as Romans 12:18 reminds us, becomes a vital principle for navigating crisis and helping those affected.
reflection.zh: 纽约州、新泽西州和康涅狄格州突如其来的洪水带来了意想不到的混乱，将一场比赛变成了与安全的搏斗。在混乱的时刻，正如罗马书12:18所提醒我们的，追求和平与秩序的呼召，成为了应对危机和帮助受影响者的重要原则。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Cancer is rising in younger adults. Faster biological aging may help explain why
title.zh: 癌症在年轻成年人中上升。更快的生物衰老可能有助于解释原因

summary.en: Cancer rates are increasing among adults under 55, with new research suggesting that accelerated biological aging might be a contributing factor. Studies indicate that individuals from more recent generations tend to exhibit biological ages older than those from earlier generations at the same chronological age, and...
summary.zh: 55岁以下成年人的癌症发病率正在上升，新的研究表明生物衰老加速可能是其中的一个因素。研究表明，与同一实际年龄的人相比，来自较近几代人的个体的生物年龄往往比来自较早几代人的个体更年长，而这种加速衰老与早发性癌症的风险增加有关。

body.en: Cancer rates are rising in adults under 55, and new research suggests accelerated biological aging may be one piece of the puzzle. Scientists found that people from more recent generations tended to have bodies that appeared biologically older than those of earlier generations at the same chronological age. Greater biological age acceleration was linked to a higher risk of early onset cancers, with specific patterns seen for lung, gastrointestinal, uterine and colorectal cancers.
body.zh: 55 岁以下成年人的癌症发病率正在上升，新的研究表明生物衰老加速可能是造成这一难题的原因之一。科学家发现，近几代人的身体往往比同年龄的前几代人的身体显得更老。生物年龄的加快与早发癌症的风险增加有关，肺癌、胃肠道癌、子宫癌和结直肠癌具有特定的模式。

reflection.en: The news of rising cancer rates in younger adults, linked to accelerated biological aging, prompts reflection on our finite time. Psalm 90:12 reminds us, 'Teach us to number our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.' This call to mindfulness encourages us to live with purpose, recognizing the preciousness of each moment.
reflection.zh: 年轻成年人癌症发病率上升的消息，与生物衰老加速有关，促使我们反思生命的有限。诗篇90:12提醒我们：“求你教我们数算自己的日子，好叫我们得着智慧的心。” 这呼吁我们活在当下，认识到每个时刻的宝贵，并以智慧度日。

verse.textEn: Teach us to number our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.
verse.textZh: 求你指教我们怎样数算自己的日子，好叫我们得着智慧的心。

title.en: Meteor showers and supermoons: Autumn's night sky highlights
title.zh: 流星雨和超级月亮：不容错过的秋季夜空亮点

summary.en: Meteor showers and supermoons: night sky phenomenons you won't want to miss
summary.zh: 流星雨和超级月亮：您不想错过的夜空现象。

reflection.en: As autumn unfolds, the night sky offers a spectacular display with meteor showers and supermoons. These celestial events remind us of the vastness and beauty of the cosmos, a testament to the Creator's handiwork. They invite us to pause and reflect on the grandeur above, finding wonder in the predictable yet awe-inspiring cycles of the universe.
reflection.zh: 随着秋季的到来，夜空中将上演流星雨和超级月亮等壮观景象。这些天体现象提醒我们宇宙的浩瀚与美丽，是大能造物主的明证。它们邀请我们驻足沉思头顶的壮丽景象，在宇宙可预测却又令人敬畏的循环中寻找奇迹。

verse.textEn: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of his hands.
verse.textZh: 诸天述说神的荣耀，穹苍传扬他的手段。

title.en: Hidden brain wiring may help keep the mind sharp as gray matter shrinks
title.zh: 隐藏的大脑线路可能有助于在灰质萎缩时保持思维敏锐

summary.en: Scientists have discovered that the brain’s short-range wiring may help protect cognition even as gray matter shrinks with age. Healthier connections just beneath the brain’s surface were linked to better language skills and appeared to weaken the impact of gray matter loss.
summary.zh: 科学家发现，大脑的短程线路可能有助于保护认知功能，即使随着年龄增长灰质萎缩。大脑表面下方更健康的连接与更好的语言技能相关，并似乎削弱了灰质损失的影响。

body.en:
Scientists at the Mark and Mary Stevens Neuroimaging and Informatics Institute (Stevens INI) at the Keck School of Medicine of USC have uncovered evidence that two neighboring types of brain tissue may work together to support thinking abilities later in life. Their findings suggest that the condition of the brain's local communication pathways could influence how strongly gray matter loss affects cognition.

The study, published in Alzheimer's & Dementia: The Journal of the Alzheimer's Association , included brain imaging and cognitive testing from 459 adults aged 60 and older living in communities across India. The research is among the first to investigate superficial white matter in a community-based population from a low- and middle-income country.

Superficial white matter forms a thin layer of nerve fibers directly beneath the gray matter covering the outside of the brain. These short, curved fibers connect nearby regions of the cerebral cortex, allowing them to exchange information. They can be thought of as local roads linking neighboring areas of the brain.

Gray matter serves a different role. It contains many of the nerve cells responsible for processing information. Together, gray matter and the white matter directly beneath it form closely connected systems that may both contribute to cognitive health.

"Gray matter and superficial white matter are physically close and may play different roles: gray matter processes information, while superficial white matter helps nearby brain regions communicate," said Yingxu Liu, PhD, a postdoctoral scholar at the Stevens INI and first author of the study. "Our findings suggest that cognitive health depends not only on how much gray matter is preserved, but also on the condition of the wiring that connects it."

To investigate these local connections, the researchers used an advanced type of diffusion MRI. This imaging technique tracks the movement of water through brain tissue, allowing scientists to examine microscopic features that conventional brain scans may not reveal.

The researchers focused on measurements related to neurite density and the amount of freely moving water surrounding these structures. Neurites are the small projections through which nerve cells send and receive signals. A lower density of neurites or an increase in free water can indicate damage or disruption in tissue associated with processes including loss of myelin, inflammation, or swelling.

Participants also underwent assessments covering several areas of cognition, including language, memory, executive function, and visuospatial ability.

The most consistent connection between superficial white matter health and cognitive performance involved language. People with healthier superficial white matter tended to perform...
body.zh: 南加州大学凯克医学院马克和玛丽史蒂文斯神经影像和信息学研究所 (Stevens INI) 的科学家们发现了证据，表明两种相邻类型的脑组织可能共同作用来支持晚年的思维能力。他们的研究结果表明，大脑局部通讯路径的状况可能会影响灰质损失对认知的影响程度。 这项研究发表在《阿尔茨海默氏症与痴呆症：阿尔茨海默氏症协会杂志》上，对居住在印度各地社区的 459 名 60 岁及以上成年人进行了脑成像和认知测试。该研究是首批调查低收入和中等收入国家社区人群浅表白质的研究之一。 浅层白质在覆盖大脑外部的灰质正下方形成一层薄薄的神经纤维。这些短而弯曲的纤维连接大脑皮层的附近区域，使它们能够交换信息。它们可以被认为是连接大脑相邻区域的局部道路。 灰质起着不同的作用。它包含许多负责处理信息的神经细胞。灰质和其正下方的白质一起形成紧密相连的系统，可能都有助于认知健康。 “灰质和浅层白质在物理上很接近，并且可能发挥不同的作用：灰质处理信息，而浅层白质帮助附近的大脑区域进行交流，”史蒂文斯 INI 的博士后学者、该研究的第一作者 Yingxu Liu 博士说。 “我们的研究结果表明，认知健康不仅取决于灰质的保留量，还取决于连接灰质的线路状况。” 为了研究这些局部联系，研究人员使用了一种先进的扩散 MRI。这种成像技术跟踪水在脑组织中的运动，使科学家能够检查传统脑部扫描可能无法揭示的微观特征。 研究人员重点关注与神经突密度和这些结构周围自由移动的水量相关的测量。神经突是神经细胞发送和接收信号的小突起。神经突密度降低或游离水增加可能表明与髓磷脂损失、炎症或肿胀等过程相关的组织损伤或破坏。 参与者还接受了涵盖多个认知领域的评估，包括语言、记忆、执行功能和视觉空间能力。 表层白质健康与认知表现之间最一致的联系涉及语言。具有健康表层白质的人往往表现......

reflection.en: The intricate design of the human brain, with its hidden pathways supporting function even in decline, points to a Creator who has woven profound wisdom into the fabric of life. Observing such complexity in nature can lead us to greater understanding and awe of Yahweh's handiwork.
reflection.zh: 人类大脑错综复杂的设计，其隐藏的通路即使在衰退中也能支持功能，这指向了一位将深刻智慧编织入生命之中的创造者。观察自然界如此复杂的结构，可以引导我们对雅伟的创造有更深的理解和敬畏。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Chemistry textbooks have been getting this wrong for nearly 100 years
title.zh: 化学教科书近100年来可能一直出错

summary.en: A fundamental chemistry concept taught for nearly a century may be incorrect, according to new research. Scientists propose that the inductive effect in neutral molecules extends only across one bond, not several as previously believed, which could simplify organic chemistry and foster innovation.
summary.zh: 根据一项新研究，近一个世纪以来教授的一个基础化学概念可能是不正确的。科学家们提出，中性分子中的诱导效应仅延伸过一个化学键，而非如先前认为的那样延伸过三四个键，这可能会简化有机化学并促进创新。

body.en: A foundational chemistry concept found in textbooks for almost 100 years may have been taught incorrectly. Researchers say the inductive effect in neutral molecules appears to extend only across one chemical bond, rather than gradually weakening over three or four bonds as traditionally taught. The team argues that updating this explanation could make organic chemistry easier to understand and provide a stronger foundation for future research and innovation.
body.zh: 近 100 年来教科书上出现的基本化学概念可能一直被错误地教授。研究人员表示，中性分子中的诱导效应似乎仅在一个化学键上延伸，而不是像传统教导的那样在三个或四个化学键上逐渐减弱。该团队认为，更新这一解释可以使有机化学更容易理解，并为未来的研究和创新提供更坚实的基础。

reflection.en: The pursuit of knowledge is a noble endeavor, and this story highlights how dedicated researchers can refine our understanding of the world. Even foundational concepts can be re-examined, leading to clearer explanations and new avenues for discovery. This persistent quest for truth mirrors the biblical idea that uncovering hidden things brings glory.
reflection.zh: 求知是一项崇高的事业，这个故事强调了敬业的研究人员如何能够完善我们对世界的理解。即使是基础概念也可以被重新审视，从而带来更清晰的解释和新的发现途径。这种对真理的不懈追求，呼应了圣经中揭示隐藏之事带来荣耀的理念。

verse.textEn: It is the glory of God to conceal a matter; to search out a matter is the glory of kings.
verse.textZh: 将事隐秘乃神的荣耀；将事察清乃君王的荣耀。

title.en: Crocodiles are famous for finding their way home. These ones didn’t
title.zh: 鳄鱼以回家闻名。这些鳄鱼却不然

summary.en: Saltwater crocodiles raised in captivity and released into Bangladesh’s Sundarbans surprised scientists by settling into the wild rather than attempting to return to their breeding facility. This finding suggests that releasing larger, mature captive crocodiles could aid in restoring depleted populations.
summary.zh: 在孟加拉国孙德尔本斯释放的圈养咸水鳄鱼，出乎科学家意料地适应了野外生活，而不是试图返回它们的繁殖地。这一发现表明，释放更大、更成熟的圈养鳄鱼可能有助于恢复数量减少的种群。

body.en:
A new study suggests that saltwater crocodiles born or raised in captivity may not try to return to their breeding centers once they are released into the wild. The finding could help conservationists improve efforts to restore declining crocodile populations.

Finding the way back home is an important behavior across the animal kingdom. For many species, it can play a major role in survival and reproduction. Some animals make short daily trips back to nests or burrows after searching for food, while others navigate across vast distances over weeks or months.

"Crocodilians, the largest predators in most tropical, subtropical freshwater and brackish environments, are a unique case when it comes to homing behavior," said behavioral ecologist and Adjunct Associate Professor Ru Somaweera, from Murdoch University.

"Crocodiles are remarkably good at finding their way home, often returning to their original capture sites and limiting the success of relocation programs. What we still don't fully understand, though, is how this behavior plays out in individuals that have been bred or kept in captivity for long periods before being released back into the wild."

Researchers carried out the study in the Sundarbans mangrove forest in Bangladesh, one of the country's last major refuges for saltwater crocodiles. Heavy commercial hunting for crocodile skins severely reduced the species in Bangladesh until the 1970s. Although saltwater crocodiles have been legally protected there since 1973, their numbers have shown no measurable recovery.

Most of the country's remaining known crocodiles are now found in the Sundarbans. Even there, the population is small, with the most recent survey estimating just 140 mature individuals.

"If crocodiles who are bred and raised in captivity subsequently return to their enclosures or breeding facilities after being released, attempts to reintroduce them into the wild as part of conservation efforts will ultimately fail," Associate Professor Somaweera said.

"The traditional approach has been to use hatchlings in reintroduction programs, but their survival rates are extremely low and they take a long time to reach reproductive maturity. Understanding whether larger, captive-bred crocodiles can be used instead represents an important knowledge gap."

To investigate, the researchers fitted five mature saltwater crocodiles with satellite tracking devices. The group included three captive-reared females that had spent 8-22 years in captivity, one local wild crocodile that was captured and then released at the same site, and another wild crocodile that was moved (translocated) a long distance from where it had been caught.

According to Associate Professor Somaweera, the most encouraging result involved the three captive-reared...
body.zh: 一项新的研究表明，圈养出生或饲养的咸水鳄鱼一旦被释放到野外，可能不会试图返回它们的繁殖中心。这一发现可以帮助自然资源保护主义者加大努力，恢复日益减少的鳄鱼数量。 寻找回家的路是整个动物王国的一个重要行为。对于许多物种来说，它可以在生存和繁殖中发挥重要作用。有些动物在寻找食物后每天都会短途返回巢穴或洞穴，而另一些动物则需要数周或数月的时间才能穿越很远的距离。 默多克大学的行为生态学家兼兼职副教授 Ru Somaweera 表示：“鳄鱼是大多数热带、亚热带淡水和咸水环境中最大的掠食者，在归巢行为方面是一个独特的例子。” “鳄鱼非常擅长找到回家的路，经常返回原来的捕获地点，这限制了重新安置计划的成功。不过，我们仍然不完全了解的是，这种行为在被放回野外之前被饲养或长期圈养的个体中是如何发挥作用的。” 研究人员在孟加拉国的孙德尔本斯红树林进行了这项研究，这里是该国最后的咸水鳄鱼主要保护区之一。直到 20 世纪 70 年代，对鳄鱼皮的大量商业狩猎严重减少了孟加拉国的鳄鱼数量。尽管咸水鳄鱼自 1973 年以来就受到法律保护，但它们的数量却没有出现明显的恢复。 该国现存的大多数已知鳄鱼现在都在孙德尔本斯发现。即使在那里，种群数量也很少，最近的调查估计只有 140 只成年个体。 索马维拉副教授说：“如果人工饲养的鳄鱼在被释放后返回其围栏或饲养设施，作为保护工作的一部分将它们重新引入野外的尝试最终将失败。” “传统的方法是在放归计划中使用刚孵化的鳄鱼，但它们的存活率极低，而且需要很长时间才能达到生殖成熟。了解是否可以使用更大的圈养鳄鱼来代替，代表着一个重要的知识差距。” 为了进行调查，研究人员给五只成熟的咸水鳄鱼安装了卫星跟踪装置。该群体包括三只人工饲养的雌性鳄鱼，它们被圈养了8-22年；一只是捕获后在同一地点释放的当地野生鳄鱼；另一只野生鳄鱼是从捕获地点转移（易位）很远的地方。 索马维拉副教授表示，最令人鼓舞的结果涉及三只圈养的……

reflection.en: The natural world holds profound lessons, often surprising us when we observe it closely. These crocodiles, expected to return home, instead demonstrated an unexpected adaptability to their new environment. This reminds us that wisdom can be found not only in our plans but also in the quiet, observable truths of creation, as Job noted that even the beasts...
reflection.zh: 大自然蕴含着深刻的教训，当我们仔细观察它时，常常会给我们带来惊喜。这些鳄鱼本应回到家园，却展现出对新环境出人意料的适应能力。这提醒我们，智慧不仅在于我们的计划，也在于被造物中那些安静、可观察的真理，正如约伯所指出的，连牲畜走兽和空中的飞鸟都能教导我们。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: This German submarine sank in 1917. It’s still leaking TNT
title.zh: 这艘德国潜艇沉没于1917年。它仍在泄漏TNT

summary.en: A World War I submarine wreck off Denmark is leaking TNT into the surrounding water, seabed, and marine life more than a century after it sank. Scientists warn that thousands of similar wrecks could pose growing environmental risks as they continue to corrode.
summary.zh: 一战时期沉没在丹麦附近的一艘德国潜艇残骸，在其沉没一个多世纪后，仍在向周围的水域、海床和海洋生物泄漏TNT。科学家警告说，数千个类似的沉船残骸可能会随着持续腐蚀而带来日益增长的环境风险。

body.en:
In April 1917, the German submarine UC-30 was making its way through waters near Rømø after abandoning a mission to Ireland because of engine problems. The vessel had turned back toward Germany and was close to reaching home.

UC-30 was carrying 18 mines and six torpedoes, leaving the submarine packed with explosives. On April 19, it struck a British mine and sank. All 27 crew members died.

For nearly a century, the wreck remained lost beneath the sea. Danish diver Gert Normann Andersen finally discovered it in 2016.

UC-30 later became one of the wrecks examined through the major NorthSeaWrecks research project. Katrine Juul Andresen, a professor at the Department of Geoscience at Aarhus University, helped investigate the site.

Working with navy divers, Andresen and her colleagues collected water and sediment from around the wreck. They also sampled starfish and mussels living on or near the submarine.

"Civilian diving is not permitted on the wreck, so we received great assistance from navy divers. After receiving instructions, they dove down and collected sediment samples, water samples, and wildlife samples from various locations on the wreck and from the surrounding seabed."

"The divers also recorded video and took photos, which we subsequently used to assess the exposure of the mines and the condition of the wreck."

The results showed that explosive material from the wreck is entering the surrounding marine environment.

"We found traces of TNT in the wildlife, the seabed, and the water column. Pollution is definitely occurring. The question is how significant the effect is and how far from the wreck the pollution impacts the marine environment. It is likely a relatively localized source of pollution, but it will worsen as the wreck continues to deteriorate and expose more of the explosive material inside the mines," she says.

During World War I, control of the North Sea was strategically vital to both Germany and Britain. Dominating the region meant controlling the movement of supplies into and out of each country, giving either side the ability to place enormous economic and military pressure on its opponent.

Germany had a smaller surface fleet than Britain, so submarines became an important part of its strategy. German submarines attempted to approach British vessels unseen and destroy them.

Both countries also relied heavily on naval mines. An estimated 190,000 mines were placed in the North Sea during WWI in hopes that enemy ships would strike them.

The region was also the site of the Battle of Jutland, fought off Hanstholm in Northern Jutland. It became the largest naval clash in history. German and British fleets battled across the North Sea, more than 25 ships were sunk, and nearly 10,000 sailors died.

Those...
body.zh: 1917 年 4 月，德国潜艇 UC-30 由于发动机问题放弃了前往爱尔兰的任务，正在穿越罗莫附近的水域。该船已返回德国，即将返航。 UC-30 携带 18 枚水雷和 6 枚鱼雷，潜艇内装满了炸药。 4月19日，它触礁沉没。 27名船员全部遇难。 近一个世纪以来，沉船一直沉没在海底。丹麦潜水员格特·诺曼·安德森 (Gert Normann Andersen) 终于在 2016 年发现了它。 UC-30 后来成为通过北海沉船研究项目进行检查的沉船之一。奥胡斯大学地球科学系教授卡特琳·朱尔·安德烈森 (Katrine Juul Andresen) 帮助调查了该地点。 安德烈森和她的同事与海军潜水员合作，从沉船周围收集了水和沉积物。他们还对生活在潜艇上或附近的海星和贻贝进行了采样。 “沉船上不允许民用潜水，因此我们得到了海军潜水员的大力帮助。他们在接到指示后潜入水中，从沉船的各个位置和周围海底收集了沉积物样本、水样和野生动物样本。” “潜水员还录制了视频和照片，我们随后用这些视频和照片来评估水雷的暴露程度和沉船的状况。” 结果显示，沉船中的爆炸物质正在进入周围的海洋环境。 “我们在野生动物、海底和水体中发现了TNT的痕迹。污染肯定正在发生。问题是影响有多大，以及污染对海洋环境的影响有多大，以及距离沉船多远。这可能是一个相对局部的污染源，但随着沉船继续恶化并暴露出更多的矿井内爆炸物质，情况将会恶化，”她说。 第一次世界大战期间，控制北海对于德国和英国都具有重要的战略意义。统治该地区意味着控制物资进出每个国家的流动，使任何一方都有能力向对手施加巨大的经济和军事压力。 德国的水面舰队规模比英国小，因此潜艇成为其战略的重要组成部分。德国潜艇试图在不被发现的情况下接近英国船只并摧毁它们。 两国还严重依赖水雷。第一次世界大战期间，估计在北海埋设了 190,000 枚水雷，希望敌舰能够对其进行攻击。 该地区也是日德兰海战的发生地，这场战役是在日德兰半岛北部与汉斯托姆岛交战的。它成为历史上最大规模的海战。德国和英国舰队横跨北海激战，超过25艘船只被击沉，近万名水手死亡。 那些...

reflection.en: The discovery of the UC-30 submarine, still leaking explosives over a century later, serves as a stark reminder of humanity's impact on the natural world. Genesis 2:15 calls us to 'work the garden and keep it.' This ancient charge is a timeless mandate to steward creation, recognizing that our actions, even those from a century ago, can have lasting...
reflection.zh: UC-30潜艇残骸的发现，在沉没一个多世纪后仍在泄漏爆炸物，这鲜明地提醒我们人类对自然界的影响。《创世记》2:15呼召我们“耕耘照料”。这一古老的命令是管理受造界的永恒使命，认识到我们的行为，即使是百年前的行为，也会对我们被呼召去保护的环境产生持久的影响。

verse.textEn: Yahweh God took the man and put him in the Garden of Eden to work it and take care of it.
verse.textZh: 雅伟神将那人安置在伊甸园，使他修理看守。

title.en: Scientists find nine new sponge species in glimpse of Alaska’s deep-sea diversity
title.zh: 科学家在阿拉斯加深海发现九种新海绵物种，一窥其多样性

summary.en: Scientists have discovered nine new species of deep-sea sponges in Alaska, contributing to our understanding of the region's largely unexplored marine biodiversity. These findings expand the known sponge species count in Alaska to 232, but their habitat faces threats from bottom trawling and potential seafloor mining.
summary.zh: 科学家在阿拉斯加发现了九种新的深海海绵物种，增进了我们对该地区未充分探索的海洋生物多样性的认识。这些发现使阿拉斯加已知的海绵物种数量增至232种，但它们的栖息地正面临海底拖网捕捞和潜在的海底采矿的威胁。

body.en: But their habitat is threatened by bottom trawling in the region and Trump’s plan to expand seafloor mining Scientists have discovered nine new deep-sea sponge species off Alaska, offering new insights into the region’s largely unexplored marine biodiversity. The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (Noaa) announced the discovery on Thursday, saying the species were found in the Gulf of Alaska and the Aleutian Islands. The findings bring the total number of known sponge species in Alaska to 232. Continue reading...
body.zh: 但它们的栖息地受到该地区海底拖网捕捞和特朗普扩大海底采矿计划的威胁。科学家们在阿拉斯加附近发现了九种新的深海海绵物种，为该地区基本上未经探索的海洋生物多样性提供了新的见解。美国国家海洋和大气管理局（Noaa）周四宣布了这一发现，称该物种是在阿拉斯加湾和阿留申群岛发现的。这些发现使阿拉斯加已知的海绵物种总数达到 232 种。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The deep sea, a realm of mystery and wonder, continues to reveal Yahweh's intricate artistry. The discovery of these nine new sponge species reminds us of the vastness of creation and the profound wisdom inherent in its design. Even as these fragile ecosystems face threats, their existence points to the Creator's boundless creativity and the importance of...
reflection.zh: 深海，一个充满神秘和奇迹的领域，不断揭示雅伟那精妙的艺术。这九种新海绵物种的发现提醒我们造物的浩瀚以及其中蕴含的深刻智慧。即使这些脆弱的生态系统面临威胁，它们的存在也彰显了造物主无限的创造力，以及珍视祂所造生命的意义。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: Starwatch: A Venus-spotting challenge with a beautiful reward
title.zh: 观星：一次挑战与美丽的回报

summary.en: This week's Starwatch feature presents a challenge: spotting the planet Venus in the early evening sky. On Monday, Venus will appear close to a young, thinly illuminated crescent moon, offering a beautiful celestial pairing for those who can find it.
summary.zh: 本周的观星指南提出了一项挑战：在傍晚时分寻找金星。周一，金星将与一弯细细的月牙近距离相伴，为成功找到它的人们带来美丽的星空景象。

body.en: The bright planet and the young crescent moon will make an attractive pairing on Monday evening This week’s Starwatch is a challenge but a beautiful reward awaits for anyone who succeeds. The question is: how early in the evening can we find Venus? On Monday, the bright planet has a close encounter with a young crescent moon. The moon will be just over three days old with about 14% of its visible surface illuminated. Unfortunately for UK observers, the two make their closest approach during daylight, passing within a moon’s width of one another around lunchtime. Continue reading...
body.zh: 这颗明亮的行星和年轻的新月将在周一晚上形成一对有吸引力的配对。本周的观星活动是一项挑战，但任何成功的人都会得到丰厚的奖励。问题是：晚上多久我们才能找到金星？周一，这颗明亮的行星与一颗年轻的新月亲密接触。月球诞生仅三天多一点，其可见表面的约 14% 会被照亮。对于英国观察者来说不幸的是，两者在白天最接近，在午餐时间彼此擦肩而过，距离只有一个月亮的宽度。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The vastness of the cosmos, with planets like Venus and the moon tracing their paths, is a constant testament to the Creator's artistry. Even when spotting them presents a challenge, the reward is a glimpse of the heavens declaring the glory of Yahweh. May we find moments to look up, to marvel at the order and beauty above, and to remember the One who...
reflection.zh: 浩瀚的宇宙，金星和月亮循着它们的轨迹运行，是造物主艺术性的永恒见证。即使寻找它们充满挑战，但回报是瞥见那宣告雅伟荣耀的穹苍。 愿我们能找到片刻抬头仰望，惊叹于上方的秩序与美丽，并记念那安排这一切的祂。

verse.textEn: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of his hands.
verse.textZh: 诸天述说神的荣耀，穹苍传扬他的手段。

title.en: Encoded and non-genetic protein variants expand human functional proteome
title.zh: 编码和非遗传蛋白质变体扩展了人类功能蛋白质组

summary.en: A new study published in Nature introduces encoded and non-genetic protein variants that significantly expand the human functional proteome. This research opens new avenues for understanding human biology and potential therapeutic interventions.
summary.zh: 发表在《自然》杂志上的一项新研究介绍了编码和非遗传蛋白质变体，它们极大地扩展了人类功能蛋白质组。这项研究为理解人类生物学和潜在的治疗干预开辟了新途径。

reflection.en: The relentless pursuit of knowledge, as seen in this scientific advancement, reflects a deep human drive to understand the intricate workings of creation. As our understanding grows, may we also cultivate the wisdom to use this knowledge for good, honoring the complexity of life itself.
reflection.zh: 科学进步中体现出的对知识的不懈追求，反映了人类理解受造物复杂运作的深层驱动力。随着我们理解的加深，愿我们也培养智慧，将这些知识用于善事，并尊重生命本身的复杂性。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: The roots of astrology, the mysterious nature of time and more: Books in brief
title.zh: 占星术的根源、时间的神秘本质等：书籍精选

summary.en: Andrew Robinson reviews five of the best science picks from Nature, covering topics such as the origins of astrology, the mysterious nature of time, and other scientific subjects.
summary.zh: Andrew Robinson 评选了《自然》杂志的五本最佳科学读物，内容涵盖占星术的起源、时间的神秘本质以及其他科学主题。

reflection.en: The relentless pursuit of knowledge, as highlighted in these science book reviews, mirrors the prophetic insight that in the end times, 'knowledge will increase.' This surge of understanding, whether about the cosmos or the human mind, calls us to seek wisdom alongside information, discerning truth in an ever-expanding sea of data. As we delve deeper into...
reflection.zh: 这些科学书籍评论所突显的对知识的不懈追求，恰如预言中所述，在末世“知识必增长”。这种对理解力的激增，无论是关于宇宙还是人类心智，都呼唤我们在信息爆炸的时代寻求智慧，在不断扩展的数据海洋中辨别真理。 当我们深入探索时间和宇宙的奥秘时，愿我们牢记，真正的智慧来自上方，以谦卑和敬畏之心引导我们的探索。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: How is climate change affecting conifers and their ability to sequester carbon?
title.zh: 气候变化如何影响针叶树及其固碳能力？

summary.en: New research indicates that a combination of factors may influence the growth of conifer trees, potentially affecting their capacity to sequester carbon.
summary.zh: 新研究表明，多种因素的相互作用可能会影响针叶树的生长，从而影响它们固碳的能力。

reflection.en: The intricate balance of ecosystems, like the one described concerning conifers and carbon sequestration, reveals the profound wisdom woven into creation. As climate change disrupts these systems, we are reminded of our role as stewards, called to understand and protect the Earth's diverse life.
reflection.zh: 生态系统的复杂平衡，例如文中关于针叶树和固碳的描述，彰显了创造中蕴含的深邃智慧。随着气候变化扰乱这些系统，我们被提醒要作为管家，理解并保护地球上多样的生命。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: The pet trade puts reptiles and amphibians at risk: close legal gaps now
title.zh: 宠物贸易危及爬行动物和两栖动物：立即堵塞法律漏洞

summary.en: Patchy legislation means that animals are routinely taken from their natural habitats and sold in other countries. Fresh national and international measures could help to stop this exploitation.
summary.zh: 零散的立法意味着动物经常被从自然栖息地捕获并在其他国家出售。新的国家和国际措施可以帮助制止这种剥削。

reflection.en: The global pet trade, driven by demand for exotic species, often leads to the unsustainable removal of reptiles and amphibians from their native environments. This practice leaves these creatures vulnerable and voiceless in the face of exploitation. Proverbs 31:8-9 calls us to speak for those who cannot speak for themselves, urging us to defend the rights...
reflection.zh: 全球宠物贸易，由对奇异物种的需求驱动，常常导致爬行动物和两栖动物在其原生环境中被不可持续地捕获。这种做法使这些生物在面临剥削时变得脆弱且无声。箴言31:8-9呼吁我们为不能自辩的开口，为一切孤苦人伸冤，为他们辩屈。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Donor-funded science is rising in Brazil ― upending a long tradition
title.zh: 巴西捐助者资助的科学正在兴起——颠覆了悠久的传统

summary.en: Philanthropists are stepping up support for research in Brazil, a country where scientists have historically relied solely on government funding. This shift marks a departure from a long-standing tradition and introduces new avenues for scientific advancement.
summary.zh: 在巴西，慈善家们正在加大对科研的支持力度，而这个国家在历史上一直仅依赖政府资助。这一转变标志着对一项悠久传统的偏离，并为科学进步开辟了新的途径。

reflection.en: In Brazil, a nation long accustomed to government-funded research, a new era is dawning as philanthropists increasingly step in to support scientific endeavors. This shift reflects a growing recognition of the value of knowledge and the diverse ways it can be cultivated. The pursuit of understanding, whether through public or private means, is a testament...
reflection.zh: 在巴西，这个长期以来习惯于政府资助科研的国家，随着慈善家们日益介入支持科学事业，一个新时代正在到来。这一转变反映了对知识价值日益增长的认识，以及培育知识的多种途径。对理解的追求，无论通过公共还是私人途径，都证明了人类的好奇心和揭示世界运作方式的愿望。

verse.textEn: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.
verse.textZh: 聪明人的心得知识；智慧人的耳求知识。

title.en: Researchers hope powerful new microscope will reveal ‘root cause’ of incurable bowel disease
title.zh: 研究人员希望强大的新显微镜能揭示不治之症肠道疾病的“根本原因”

summary.en: A new microscope, 'Curie,' operating at ten times the resolution of conventional technology, is expected to accelerate discoveries for treating debilitating and incurable bowel conditions like Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, which affect over half a million people in the UK.
summary.zh: 一种名为“居里”的新型显微镜，其分辨率是传统技术的十倍，有望加速治疗克罗恩病和溃疡性结肠炎等使人衰弱且无法治愈的肠道疾病的发现，这些疾病影响着英国超过五十万人。

body.en: No run-of-the-mill tech, ‘Curie’ operates at 10 times the resolution of conventional microscopy and could spur discoveries leading to new treatment The number of young people living with debilitating and incurable bowel conditions worldwide is growing , but researchers now hope a one-of-a-kind microscope will help them understand such diseases and find new treatments. According to the British Society of Gastroenterology, more than half a million people in the UK are living with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), with Crohn’s disease and ulcerative colitis the two main forms. Continue reading...
body.zh: “居里”不是普通的技术，它的运行分辨率是传统显微镜的 10 倍，可以激发新的治疗方法的发现。全世界患有虚弱和无法治愈的肠道疾病的年轻人数量正在增加，但研究人员现在希望一种独一无二的显微镜能够帮助他们了解此类疾病并找到新的治疗方法。根据英国胃肠病学会的数据，英国有超过 50 万人患有炎症性肠病 (IBD)，其中克罗恩病和溃疡性结肠炎是两种主要疾病。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The relentless pursuit of knowledge, exemplified by researchers using the 'Curie' microscope, mirrors the ancient wisdom of seeking understanding through careful observation. By peering into the intricate workings of the body, these scientists echo the Psalmist's wonder at creation, trusting that deeper insight into disease will lead to healing.
reflection.zh: 研究人员使用“居里”显微镜所体现出的不懈求知精神，呼应了通过仔细观察寻求理解的古老智慧。通过深入了解身体的复杂运作，这些科学家呼应了诗篇作者对受造界的惊叹，并相信对疾病的更深入了解将带来治愈。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Live episode: how AI is reshaping our minds – podcast
title.zh: 直播：人工智能如何重塑我们的思想——播客

summary.en: This episode of Science Weekly, recorded live at the London podcast festival on September 3rd, features Ian Sample interviewing Michael Safi, host of The Guardian's AI podcast 'Black Box'. In its second series, 'Black Box: the chatbots', Safi meets individuals who believe AI chatbots have helped them achieve...
summary.zh: 在本期于9月3日在伦敦播客节现场录制的“科学周刊”节目中，伊恩·桑普尔采访了《卫报》关于人工智能的播客“黑匣子”的主持人迈克尔·萨菲。在第二季“黑匣子：聊天机器人”中，萨菲采访了那些相信人工智能聊天机器人帮助他们取得了科学突破、治愈疾病或发明了新技术的个人。伊恩、迈克尔和联合主持人马德琳·芬利探讨了被称为“人工智能精神...

body.en: In this episode of Science Weekly, recorded in front of an audience at the London podcast festival on 3 September, Ian Sample hears from Michael Safi, the host of the Guardian’s chart-topping podcast about artificial intelligence, Black Box. In series two, Black Box: the chatbots, Michael meets people who have become convinced they have made scientific breakthroughs, cured diseases or invented new technologies using AI chatbots. Ian, Michael and Science Weekly’s co-host Madeleine Finlay explore the phenomenon labelled ‘AI psychosis’ and ask what it reveals about a technology now used by more than a billion people Listen to Black Box: the chatbots Support the Guardian: theguardian.com/sciencepod Continue reading...
body.zh: 在 9 月 3 日伦敦播客节上在观众面前录制的这一期《科学周刊》中，伊恩·萨普 (Ian Sample) 聆听了《卫报》排行榜上关于人工智能的播客 Black Box 的主持人迈克尔·萨菲 (Michael Safi) 的发言。在第二季《黑匣子：聊天机器人》中，迈克尔遇到了一些人，他们确信自己已经利用人工智能聊天机器人取得了科学突破、治愈了疾病或发明了新技术。伊恩、迈克尔和《科学周刊》的联合主持人玛德琳·芬利探讨了被称为“人工智能精神病”的现象，并询问它揭示了一项目前有超过 10 亿人使用的技术的哪些内容。听《黑匣子》：聊天机器人支持《卫报》：theguardian.com/sciencepod 继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence, as explored in this podcast, presents humanity with unprecedented knowledge and capabilities. Daniel's prophecy speaks of a time when 'knowledge will increase,' a fitting description for our current technological era. As we navigate these powerful tools, may we seek wisdom and discernment, ensuring that this...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展，正如本次播客所探讨的，为人类带来了前所未有的知识和能力。但以理的预言谈到了一个“知识增长”的时代，这恰如其分地描述了我们当前的科技时代。当我们驾驭这些强大的工具时，愿我们寻求智慧和分辨力，确保这日益增长的知识能够服务于人类真正的福祉。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Fossilized 10,000-year-old mastodon tooth found by California scientist
title.zh: 科学家发现一万年前乳齿象牙齿化石

summary.en: A California scientist has discovered a 10,000-year-old mastodon tooth in 'immaculate condition' in San Mateo County. The molar from the large mammal, which once roamed North America, was found by geomorphologist Brigid Lynch while working at a preserve.
summary.zh: 一位加州科学家在圣马特奥县发现了一颗保存完好的1万年前的乳齿象牙齿化石。这颗属于曾漫步于北美的大型哺乳动物的臼齿，是由地貌学家布里吉德·林奇在保护区工作时发现的。

body.en: Molar from large mammal that once lived in North America is in ‘immaculate condition’ after discovery in Bay Area A 10,000 year-old tooth in remarkable condition from an ancient Pacific mastodon, a large mammal that once inhabited North America, was recently discovered by a California scientist. Brigid Lynch, a geomorphologist, was working at a preserve in San Mateo county, when she stumbled across a peculiar rock. Continue reading...
body.zh: 湾区发现的曾经生活在北美的大型哺乳动物的臼齿在湾区被发现后仍处于“完美状态”最近，加州的一位科学家发现了一颗古老的太平洋乳齿象的牙齿，其状态非常好。太平洋乳齿象是一种曾经生活在北美的大型哺乳动物。地貌学家布里吉德·林奇 (Brigid Lynch) 在圣马特奥县的一个保护区工作时，偶然发现了一块奇特的岩石。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The discovery of this ancient mastodon tooth is a tangible link to a distant past, reminding us of the vastness of time and the creatures that once inhabited our world. It speaks to the deep wisdom embedded in creation, waiting to be uncovered through careful observation and scientific inquiry.
reflection.zh: 这颗古老的乳齿象牙齿化石的发现，是通往遥远过去的切实联系，提醒我们时间的浩瀚以及曾经栖息在我们世界上的生物。它体现了造物中蕴含的深刻智慧，等待着通过细致的观察和科学的探索而被揭示。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Technology Desk
title.zh: 科技前沿

strap.en: Technology shaping how we live, work, and think.
strap.zh: 正在改变生活、工作与思考方式的科技动态。

title.en: Republican senator Mitch McConnell returns to Capitol Hill after months-long hiatus while recovering from fall – live
title.zh: 特朗普声称他才是控制人工智能的“唯一保障”，顶级共和党人与他一同驳斥要求加强监管的呼声——直播

summary.en: Donald Trump has claimed there is a “SICK conspiracy” against artificial intelligence and data centers in response to the growing calls for greater checks on AI development. "The only control or ‘guardrails’ that AI needs is a STRONG AND SMART (High IQ!) PRESIDENT, and the U.S.A. has that, in spades!" Trump wrote on...
summary.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普声称，面对日益增长的对人工智能发展加强监管的呼声，存在着针对人工智能和数据中心的“恶毒阴谋”。特朗普在Truth Social上写道：“人工智能唯一需要的控制或‘保障’是一个强大而聪明（高智商！）的总统，而美国拥有这样的总统，而且绰绰有余！”...

body.en: McConnell returns to Congress to vote for the first time in several months and says in a statement, ‘I’m really looking forward to being back on the Senate floor’ Sign up for the Breaking News US email Donald Trump has claimed there is a “SICK conspiracy” against artificial intelligence and data centers in response to the growing calls for greater checks on AI development. “The only control or ‘guardrails’ that AI needs is a STRONG AND SMART (High IQ!) PRESIDENT, and the U.S.A. has that, in spades!” Trump wrote on Truth Social, insisting that the administration has stopped leaders of AI companies from “doing bad, or potentially bad” things. However, he didn’t point to any concrete examples for how he has curbed possible abuse or malfeasance in the industry. There is a SICK conspiracy going on against AI and Data Centers, and the only one that is happy about it is China … We are leading China, and all others, and will continue to do so. Conspiracy Theorists, Treasonists, Traitors, and Leakers, BEWARE! Continue reading...
body.zh: 在首席执行官呼吁放慢发展速度后，总统谴责了他所称的全球科技股抛售中的“病态阴谋”。唐纳德·特朗普声称存在针对人工智能和数据中心的“病态阴谋”，以回应日益增长的对人工智能发展进行更严格检查的呼声。 “人工智能需要的唯一控制或‘护栏’是一位坚强而聪明（高智商！）的总统，而美国确实拥有这样的总统！”特朗普在 Truth Social 上撰文，坚称政府已阻止人工智能公司领导人“做坏事或可能坏事”。然而，他没有举出任何具体例子来说明他如何遏制该行业可能存在的滥用或渎职行为。一场针对人工智能和数据中心的阴谋正在上演，唯一对此感到高兴的是中国……我们正在领导中国和所有其他国家，并将继续这样做。阴谋论者、叛国者、叛徒和泄密者，请当心！继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the complex landscape of artificial intelligence, calls for caution and regulation are met with claims that political strength alone is sufficient control. This raises questions about the value of expertise and the pursuit of knowledge itself. Proverbs 18:15 reminds us that the wise person seeks knowledge, and the ear of the knowledgeable seeks it out,...
reflection.zh: 在人工智能复杂的格局中，要求谨慎和监管的呼声遇到了声称仅靠政治力量就足以控制的说法。这引发了关于专业知识的价值以及知识本身追求的问题。《箴言》18:15提醒我们，智慧人寻求知识，而通达人的耳寻求知识，这表明了一条通过知情理解而非仅仅依赖权威的道路。

verse.textEn: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.
verse.textZh: 聪明人的心得知识；智慧人的耳求知识。

title.en: AI-linked stocks slide after tech bosses call for slowdown in ‘reckless’ development
title.zh: 人工智能相关股票下跌，因科技巨头呼吁“鲁莽”发展放缓

summary.en: AI-linked stocks fell on Monday after the heads of major AI companies, including OpenAI and SpaceX, urged a pause in "reckless" development due to fears of the technology spiraling out of control. This led to a drop in shares of companies like Nvidia, AMD, and Micron Technology, with the Nasdaq index also experiencing...
summary.zh: 周一，在包括OpenAI和SpaceX在内的主要人工智能公司负责人呼吁暂停“鲁莽”发展，并担心技术可能失控之后，与人工智能相关的股票下跌。这导致英伟达、AMD和美光科技等公司的股价下跌，纳斯达克指数也小幅下滑。

body.en: Donald Trump dismisses attempts to increase controls on artificial intelligence as ‘sick conspiracy’ AI -linked stocks tumbled on Monday after the bosses of Anthropic, OpenAI and SpaceX called for a slowdown in AI “reckless” development , citing fears the technology could soon run out of control. Shares in the semiconductor designer Nvidia – the world’s most valuable company – were down 3.3% by market closing in New York City, while Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) slid 4% and Micron Technology and Sandisk shares slumped by 5%. The tech-heavy Nasdaq index fund was down 0.5% by the end of the day. Continue reading...
body.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普驳回了加强对人工智能控制的尝试，称其为“病态阴谋”，周一，在 Anthropic、OpenAI 和 SpaceX 的老板呼吁人工智能“鲁莽”发展放缓，理由是担心该技术可能很快失控后，与人工智能相关的股票暴跌。截至纽约市收盘，全球市值最高的半导体设计公司英伟达 (Nvidia) 的股价下跌 3.3%，超微半导体公司 (AMD) 的股价下跌 4%，美光科技 (Micron Technology) 和 Sandisk 的股价下跌 5%。以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数基金截至收盘时下跌 0.5%。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence presents a profound test for its creators and society. As leaders in the field call for caution, the market reacts, demonstrating how new frontiers of innovation are met with both excitement and apprehension. This moment calls for wisdom and discernment, weighing the potential benefits against the risks, and...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的快速发展对其创造者和社会提出了严峻的考验。随着该领域的领导者呼吁谨慎，市场做出了反应，这表明创新的新前沿既带来了兴奋，也带来了担忧。这一时刻需要智慧和辨别力，权衡潜在的好处与风险，并寻求用道德指南针来引导这项强大的技术。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

title.en: Burning Man at 40: the once anarchic desert festival faces a midlife crisis
title.zh: 燃烧人节40周年：曾经无政府主义的沙漠音乐节面临中年危机

summary.en: Burning Man, the counter-culture arts festival in the Nevada desert, is celebrating its 40th anniversary and showing signs of aging. The event, once a haven for San Francisco's underground scene, is experiencing an influx of the super-rich, with chartered flights and HBO documentaries highlighting internal power...
summary.zh: 内华达沙漠中著名的艺术节“燃烧人节”迎来了它的40周年，并显露出中年危机的一些迹象。这个曾经是旧金山地下文化亚文化的“狂欢节”，正面临着超级富豪的涌入，以及包机直飞沙漠和HBO关于幕后权力斗争的纪录片。每年聚集在荒野中创造一个帐篷城的数万人似乎正在变老，而且似乎没有足够多的年轻“燃烧者”来接替他们，这表明了节日参与者的...

body.en: The subversive bacchanal for San Francisco’s eccentric underground is ageing out amid an influx of the super-rich Burning Man , the infamous arts festival in the Nevada desert, turned 40 this year, and it’s showing some distinct signs of middle age. It’s not just the tech billionaires who show up to party, the chartered flights straight to the desert or the HBO documentary about behind-the-scenes power struggles . The tens of thousands of people who assemble each year to create a tent city in the wilderness appear to be growing older, and it doesn’t seem that they’re being replaced by as many younger “burners”, as festival participants are called. Continue reading...
body.zh: 随着超级富豪的涌入，旧金山古怪的地下音乐节的颠覆性狂欢正在老化。火人节是内华达州沙漠中臭名昭著的艺术节，今年已迎来 40 周年，并显示出一些明显的中年迹象。出席派对的不仅仅是科技亿万富翁、直飞沙漠的包机或 HBO 讲述幕后权力斗争的纪录片。每年聚集在荒野中建造帐篷城市的数以万计的人似乎都在变老，而且他们似乎并没有被那么多年轻的“燃烧者”（节日参与者被称为“燃烧者”）取代。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The article notes that Burning Man, turning 40, is showing signs of middle age, with its original counter-culture ethos seemingly giving way to a more mainstream, affluent crowd. This mirrors the biblical observation that 'there is a time for everything, and a season for every activity under the heavens.' As the festival ages, its purpose and identity are...
reflection.zh: 文章指出，“燃烧人节”在迎来40周年之际，显露出中年危机。其最初的反主流文化精神似乎正被更为主流、富裕的群体所取代。这呼应了圣经中“凡事都有定期，天下万务都有定时”的观察。随着节日的发展，它的宗旨和身份正在转变，这促使我们反思传统如何演变，以及它们最初的精神能否在人生的不同季节中得以延续。

verse.textEn: There is a time for everything, and a season for every activity under the heavens.
verse.textZh: 凡事都有定期，天下万务都有定时。

title.en: OpenAI stuck fighting Musk antitrust suit after Apple finds a way out
title.zh: OpenAI 在苹果找到出路后，仍需应对马斯克的反垄断诉讼
